qe: Which layer of the atmosphere is most ideal for flying 'Jet Aircrafts'?
qh: 'जेट विमानों' को उड़ाने के लिए वायुमंडल की कौन सी परत सबसे आदर्श है?
e: Vayu mandal (atmosphere) ki sabse upari parat stratosphere hai, jo troposphere ke theek upar 20 se 50 km tak faili hai. Ismein hawa ka vertical movement bilkul kam hota hai aur ozone layer ki wajah se temperature upar ki taraf badhta hai, isliye yahan hawa bahut sthir rehti hai. Aeroplane ko sujhav (smooth) udaan chahiye, aur stratosphere isi liye jet aircraft ke liye aadarsh hai. Mesosphere mein meteor (ulka) jal jaati hai, thermosphere mein satellite ghoomte hain, aur troposphere mein baadal-barsaat hoti hai jahan turbulence milta hai. Exam point: ozone layer + jet flight dono stratosphere ki visheshta hain.

qe: What is the 'Albedo' of a surface?
qh: किसी सतह का 'एल्बीडो' (Albedo) क्या होता है?
e: Kisi bhi surface ki jitni shakti (energy) wapas chandrama ki tarah reflect karti hai, uske anupat (ratio) ko albedo kehte hain. Barf (snow) ka albedo sabse zyada hota hai kyunki wo safed hai aur suraj ki kiranein wapas bhej deta hai. Samundar aur jungle ka albedo kam hota hai isliye wo zyada garmi soak karte hain. Isi wajah se polar region thande rehte hain. Options mein diya gaya 'energy emitted' ya 'heat absorbed' galat hai kyunki albedo emission ya absorption nahi, reflection ka maap hai. Exam point: albedo = reflection ki chamta, % mein likha jaata hai.

qe: The 'Equinox' occurs when the Sun is vertically overhead above the:
qh: 'विषुव' (Equinox) तब होता है जब सूर्य लंबवत किसके ऊपर होता है?
e: Equinox do din hota hai - 21 March aur 23 September - jab suraj ki kiranein theek bhoomi-madhya rekha (Equator) ke upar 90 degree par padti hain. Us din poore vishwa mein din aur raat barabar (12-12 ghante) hote hain. Tropic of Cancer (23.5 degree N) par suraj 21 June ko aur Tropic of Capricorn par 22 December ko lambavat padta hai, wo solstice kehte hain. Isliye equinox ka jawab Equator hai. Exam point: 21 March = spring equinox, 23 September = autumn equinox, aur 21 June sabse lamba din northern hemisphere mein.

qe: Which primary greenhouse gas contributes significantly to global atmospheric warming?
qh: 'ग्रीनहाउस प्रभाव' के लिए कौन सी प्रमुख गैस जिम्मेदार है?
e: Greenhouse gas wo gas hai jo bhoomi se nikalne wali infralal (heat) kiranein rok leti hai aur wapas bhej deti hai, jisse atmosphere garam hoti hai. Carbon Dioxide (CO2) ka sabse zyada hissa manav gatividhiyon (industry, gaadi, koyla jalana) se aata hai, isliye ye mukhya greenhouse gas maana jaata hai. Nitrogen aur Oxygen vayu mein sabse zyada hain lekin ye heat ko rokne mein kam asar rakhte hain. Argon ek nishkriya gas hai. Exam point: CO2 ke baad methane, nitrous oxide aur CFC bhi greenhouse gases hain, phir bhi CO2 ka yogdan sabse zyada hai.

qe: Which layer of the Earth's atmosphere contains the vital Ozone Layer?
qh: वायुमंडल की किस परत में ओजोन परत पाई जाती है?
e: Ozone layer (ozone parat) stratosphere mein 15 se 35 km ki unchai par hoti hai. Ozone gas (O3) suraj se aane wali hani karak ultra-violet (UV) kiranein sokh leti hai, isse zameen par jeevan surakshit rehta hai. Troposphere mein mausam hota hai, mesosphere mein taare toot-te hain, exosphere sabse bahri parat hai jahan se atoms bachke nikal jaate hain. Isliye ozone layer stratosphere mein hi hai. Exam point: ozone hole Antarctica ke upar banta hai; Montreal Protocol (1987) ne ozone-sokhne wale CFC gases par rok lagayi.

qe: What is the average global equilibrium surface temperature maintained by the greenhouse effect?
qh: ग्रीनहाउस प्रभाव द्वारा पृथ्वी का औसत वैश्विक सतह तापमान लगभग कितना बनाए रखा जाता है?
e: Greenhouse effect ke bina prithvi ka average (ausat) surface temperature lagbhag -18 degree C hota. Lekin CO2, methane aur jallvaashp (water vapour) jaise greenhouse gases bhoomi ki garmi ko rok kar ise badha dete hain, jisse average surface temperature lagbhag 15 degree C ban jaata hai - yahi bhoomi par jeevan ke liye anukool hai. 0 degree C, 50 degree C ya -18 degree C galat hain kyunki ye actual santulan (equilibrium) ke maan nahi hain. Exam point: yahi 33 degree C ka antar 'natural greenhouse effect' kehlata hai; iske bina prithvi barf jaisi thandi hoti.

qe: Which atmospheric gas accounts for approximately 21% of dry air by volume?
qh: पृथ्वी के शुष्क वायुमंडल में कौन सी गैस लगभग 21% आयतन बनाती है?
e: Shushk (dry) vayu mein Nitrogen lagbhag 78%, Oxygen lagbhag 21%, Argon lagbhag 0.93% aur Carbon Dioxide lagbhag 0.04% hoti hai. Isliye 21% hissa Oxygen ka hai. Nitrogen nishkriya (inert) gas hai, Argon bhi nishkriya hai aur bahut kam matra mein hai, aur CO2 ka hissa sirf 0.04% hai. Oxygen saans lene aur jalne (combustion) dono ke liye zaroori hai. Exam point: jallvaashp (water vapour) ko chhod kar dry air ke percentages yaad rakho - Nitrogen 78, Oxygen 21, Argon 0.93, CO2 0.04.

qe: Which wind system is primarily responsible for winter precipitation along the Tamil Nadu coast?
qh: सर्दियों के दौरान तमिलनाडु के तटीय क्षेत्रों में वर्षा के लिए कौन सी पवनें जिम्मेदार हैं?
e: Tamil Nadu ke Coromandel coast par October se December ke beech barish kaun karata hai? Us samay dakshin-pashchim monsoon kamzor pad chuka hota hai aur Bay of Bengal se hawa dakshin-poorv disha se aane lagti hai, jise North-East (Retreating) Monsoon kehte hain. Ye hawa samundar se naamta (moisture) lekar aati hai aur Tamil Nadu ke coast par barish karati hai. South-West monsoon to June-September mein aati hai aur pashchimi ghats ko bhigo kar Tamil Nadu ko sookha chhod jaati hai. Nor'westers Bengal ki local aandhi hain. Exam point: retreating monsoon = Tamil Nadu ki barish ka raaz.

qe: What is the 'Diurnal Temperature Range', and in which biome is it typically highest?
qh: 'दैनिक तापांतर' क्या है, और यह सामान्यतः कहाँ सबसे अधिक दर्ज किया जाता है?
o: Difference between maximum day and minimum night temperatures; Hot Arid Deserts
Difference in rainfall over 24 hours; Polar regions
e: 'Diurnal Temperature Range' ka matlab hai ek hi din ke andar sabse garm (maximum) aur sabse thandi (minimum) temperature ke beech ka antar. Registan (desert) mein din mein suraj se tez garmi hoti hai lekin raat mein tivr vaigyanik vikiran (radiative cooling) se turant thanda ho jaata hai kyunki wahan baadal aur jallvaashp nahi hote jo garmi rok sakein. Isliye Thar jaisa garam registan is range mein sabse aage hai. Samundri ilaake mein jallvaashp garmi rokta hai to antar kam rehta hai. Exam point: desert mein din-raat ka bahut bada antar = 30 degree C tak.

qe: Which three circulation cells form the global 'Tri-cellular model' of the atmosphere?
qh: वायुमंडलीय परिसंचरण के 'त्रि-कोशकीय मॉडल' में कौन सी तीन कोशिकाएं शामिल हैं?
e: Vishwa ki hawa ka sampoorn paripatra (circulation) teen cells se banta hai - Hadley cell (Equator se 30 degree tak), Ferrel cell (30 se 60 degree tak) aur Polar cell (60 se dhruv tak). Inhi teen cells ko milakar tri-cellular model kehte hain. Hadley cell se paschatya vyapari hawaayein (trade winds) aur mausami hawaayein banti hain. Walker cell ek local samundri-khamandal (ocean-atmosphere) parighadan hai, aur monsoon ek mausami hawa ka badlav hai, na ki global cell. Exam point: Hadley + Ferrel + Polar = tri-cellular model.

qe: Which cloud variety exhibits great vertical development and generates severe thunderstorms?
qh: भारी वर्षा, तड़ित-झंझा और गरज के लिए किस प्रकार के ऊर्ध्वाधर बादल जिम्मेदार हैं?
e: Cumulonimbus sabse uncha aur ghana baadal hai, jo 10 se 12 km ki unchai tak seedha upar ki taraf badhta hai. Isi baadal ke andar tez hawa ka chakkar (updraft aur downdraft) banta hai jisse bijli chamakti hai, badi barsaat, ole (hail) aur toofani aandhi aati hai. Cirrus patle berkh (feather) jaise baadal hote hain jo mausam sukhne ka ishara hain, stratus ek hi parat mein faila halka baadal hai, aur altocumulus chhoti-chhoti goli jaise baadal ki parat hai. Exam point: cumulonimbus = badi unchai + bijli + toofani barsaat.

qe: Which latitudinal thermal belt receives maximum insolation because the Sun culminates at the zenith at least once annually?
qh: किस ताप कटिबंध में सर्वाधिक सौर ऊर्जा प्राप्त होती है क्योंकि वर्ष में कम से कम एक बार सूर्य सिर के ठीक ऊपर होता है?
e: Suraj ki kiranein poore saal sabse zyada seedhi (lambavat) Torrid Zone ya Ushn kateebandh (23.5 degree N se 23.5 degree S) par padti hain kyunki suraj yahan ke kisi na kisi sthaan par saal mein kam se kam ek baar theek upar aata hai. Isliye yahan sabse zyada tapmai (insolation) milti hai aur 'torrid' (garam) naam banta hai. Frigid zone mein kiranein tirchi (oblique) padti hain, temperate zone mein madhyam, aur sub-polar low ek dabaav kateebandh hai tapmai kateebandh nahi. Exam point: maximum insolation = Torrid zone = 23.5 N se 23.5 S.

qe: Why are polar 'Frigid Zones' characterized by perennially low temperatures?
qh: 'शीत कटिबंध' (Frigid Zone) में अत्यधिक ठंड रहने का प्राथमिक खगोलीय कारण क्या है?
o: Solar rays arrive at low, highly oblique angles and never rise high above the horizon
The Sun passes overhead during winter
e: Frigid zone (thanda kateebandh) sannikarsh (pole) ke paas bharatvritt (latitude) 66.5 degree se aage hai. Wahan suraj ki kiranein bahut tirchi disha se aati hain aur kabhi seedha sar ke upar nahi aati, isliye ek hi jagah par garmi bahut kam matra mein milti hai aur poori tarah bikhri (spread) rehti hai. Iske alava yahan saal ka bada hissa suraj ast nahi hota ya bahut kam rehta hai. 'Absence of atmospheric pressure' galat hai kyunki vayu dabaav har jagah hai, aur suraj wahan sadhaarn ke taur par sar ke upar nahi aata. Exam point: tirchi kiranein = kam tapmai = thanda dhruv pradesh.

qe: Which gas constitutes the single largest volume fraction (around 78%) of Earth's atmosphere?
qh: पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल का लगभग 78% भाग किस गैस से बना है?
e: Prithvi ke vayu mandal mein volumetric (aayatan ke hisaab se) sabse badi hissa Nitrogen ka hai - lagbhag 78%. Oxygen 21%, Argon 0.93% aur Carbon Dioxide sirf 0.04% hai. Nitrogen ek nishkriya (inert) gas hai jo jalne ya saadne (burning) mein seedha bhaag nahi leti, lekin jeevon ke shareer ki protein aur DNA mein zaroori hai. Isliye 'sabse badi matra' ka jawab Nitrogen hi hota hai. Exam point: atmosphere ka 99% hissa Nitrogen aur Oxygen se mil kar bana hai.

qe: In which atmospheric layer does virtually all convective weather activity and cloud formation occur?
qh: वायुमंडल की किस परत में मेघ निर्माण और लगभग सभी मौसमी परिघटनाएं घटित होती हैं?
e: Troposphere vayu mandal ki sabse nichli parat hai, jo zameen ki satah se lagbhag 8 km (dhruv par) se 18 km (Equator par) tak hoti hai. Vayu mein jallvaashp (water vapour), dhool aur baadal isi parat mein hote hain, aur yahan hawa ka vertical hilna-jhoolna (convection) sabse zyada hota hai. Isi karan yahan baadal banna, barsaat, toofan aur poori mausam ki ghatnayein hoti hain. Stratosphere sthir hai, mesosphere mein taare toot-te hain aur thermosphere mein gas ke aayan (ions) bante hain. Exam point: 'mausam ki sabhi ghatnayein troposphere mein' - yahi sabse zyada poocha jaata hai.

qe: What happens to ambient atmospheric pressure with increasing elevation from mean sea level?
qh: समुद्र तल से ऊँचाई बढ़ने पर वायुमंडलीय दाब में क्या परिवर्तन होता है?
e: Samundar ki satah (mean sea level) se jitna upar jaayenge, utni hi hawa patli (thin) hoti jaayegi, isliye vayu dabaav (atmospheric pressure) kam hota jaata hai. Aisa isliye hota hai kyunki dabaav us hawa ke khaambh (column) ke bhaar se banta hai jo upar tak faila hota hai - unchaai badhne par ye khaamb chhota ho jaata hai. Isliye pahadon par saans lene mein dikkat hoti hai aur paani kam tapman par ubalta hai. Dabaav kabhi badhta nahi, kabhi sthir nahi rehta. Exam point: har 165 m unchai par lagbhag 1 mm mercury dabaav ghatta hai (ya har 10 m par lagbhag 1 mb).

qe: Horizontal movement of air generated by pressure gradient differences is termed:
qh: दाब प्रवणता के कारण उच्च दाब से निम्न दाब की ओर होने वाली वायु की क्षैतिज गति को क्या कहते हैं?
e: Hawa ka horizontal (kshetij) disha mein chalna hi 'wind' (pawan) kehlata hai. Ye hawa udvastak (high pressure) ilaake se mandak (low pressure) ilaake ki taraf chalti hai - yahi pressure gradient force kehte hain. Samundar ki lehrein (tides) chandrama ki gravitation se banti hain, aur ocean currents samundar ke andar paani ka pravah hai, hawa ka nahi. Advection fog wo dhund hai jo garm naam hawa thandi satah ke upar se guzarne par banti hai. Exam point: hawa ka chalna = kshetr ke dabaav antar ka parinaam, aur Coriolis force uski disha mod deti hai.

qe: Why does the Bay of Bengal spawn more frequent tropical cyclones than the Arabian Sea?
qh: अरब सागर की तुलना में बंगाल की खाड़ी में अधिक चक्रवात उत्पन्न होने का मुख्य कारण क्या है?
o: Lower sea temperatures and low humidity
Higher sea surface temperatures, low vertical wind shear, and abundant freshwater runoff
e: Bay of Bengal mein Arabian Sea ke muqable zyada cyclone banate hain kyunki yahan samundar ki satah ka temperature zyada (27 degree C se upar) hota hai, jisse bhaap (evaporation) tej hoti hai. Iske alava yahan pawan ki vertical kajal (wind shear) kam hoti hai, matlab cyclone ko todne wali upari hawaayein kam hoti hain. Himalaya se aane wali nadiyan yahan taja paani (freshwater runoff) ka parat banati hain jo garam paani ko upar rakhta hai. Isliye yahan 4 ke muqable 3 guna zyada cyclone aate hain. Exam point: Bay of Bengal India ka 'cyclone capital' hai - Odisha, Andhra, Bengal sabse zyada prabhavit.

qe: Which scientific instrument measures atmospheric pressure in meteorological stations?
qh: वायुमंडलीय दाब मापने के लिए किस मौसम वैज्ञानिक उपकरण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Vayu mandal ke dabaav (atmospheric pressure) ko naapne wala yantra barometer kehlata hai. Iska aavishkar Torricelli ne kiya tha; mercury barometer mein paare (mercury) ka stambh dabaav ke hisaab se upar-neeche hota hai. Hygrometer hawa ki naamta (humidity) naapta hai, anemometer hawa ki gati (speed) aur thermometer tapman naapta hai. Cyclone ke samay dabaav girne se barometer sabse pehle chetavni deta hai. Exam point: barometer = dabaav, barograph = dabaav ka nirantar record, isobar = samaan dabaav wali rekha.

qe: Which rainfall mechanism predominates in equatorial doldrums due to daily solar heating and buoyant uplift?
qh: विषुवतीय शांत कटिबंध में दैनिक सौर तापन और संवहन के कारण कौन सी वर्षा प्रमुख रूप से होती है?
e: Equator ke aas-paas ke doldrum (shant kateebandh) mein suraj poore saal seedha chandata hai, isliye zameen aur hawa tez garam hoti hai. Garam hawa halki hokar upar uthti hai, jahan thandak se jallvaashp sanghanit (condense) hokar ghana badal aur roz dopahar ke baad zor ki barsaat karati hai - ise convectional rainfall kehte hain. Orographic rainfall pahad ke aanch (barrier) se hoti hai, frontal wo hai jab garm aur thandi hawaayein milti hain, aur cyclonic dabaav ke chakkar se hoti hai. Exam point: doldrum ki rozana shyam ki barsaat = convectional rainfall ka best example.

qe: Why do the western windward slopes of the Western Ghats receive markedly higher rainfall than the eastern leeward side?
qh: पश्चिमी घाट का पश्चिमी ढाल अपने पूर्वी ढाल की तुलना में अधिक वर्षा क्यों प्राप्त करता है?
o: Absence of vegetation on the eastern slope
Orographic barrier forced ascent of moist oceanic winds on windward slopes
e: Pashchimi Ghat ek uncha parvat aanch (barrier) hai. June se September ke beech dakshin-pashchim monsoon hawa Bay of Bengal ke upar se naamta lekar aati hai aur pashchimi Ghat se takrayi to upar chadhne lagti hai. Unchaai badhne par hawa thandi hoti hai, jallvaashp sanghanit hota hai aur windward (hawa ke saamne wali) dhalan par bhaari barsaat hoti hai. Doosri taraf (leeward, purba dhalan) hawa sookhi utarti hai kyunki uski naamta khatam ho chuki hoti hai - yahi rain shadow kehte hain. Isliye Mahabaleshwar mein 600 cm aur Pune mein sirf 50 cm barish hoti hai. Exam point: windward = zyada barish, leeward = rain shadow.

qe: Why are subtropical high-pressure belts (horse latitudes around 30° N/S) associated with global trade-wind deserts?
qh: उपोष्ण उच्च दाब पेटियां (लगभग 30° अक्षांश) मरुस्थलों के विकास के लिए क्यों अनुकूल होती हैं?
o: Large-scale subsidence of dry air creating adiabatic warming and suppressing cloud formation
Persistent rising air producing cyclonic clouds
e: Bharatvritt 30 degree north aur south ke paas udvastak (high pressure) kateebandh hote hain jinhe horse latitudes kehte hain. Yahan upari vayu dheere-dheere niche baithti (subsidence) hai, jisse hawa dabne se garam aur sookhi ho jaati hai (adiabatic warming) aur baadal banne ki prakriya ruk jaati hai. Isliye yahan registan bante hain - jaise Thar, Sahara, Arabian. Doldrum to Equator ke paas mandak kateebandh hai jahan barsaat hoti hai, aur polar front 60 degree ke paas hai. Exam point: horse latitudes = subsidence + sookhi hawa = vishwa ke mukhya registan.

qe: What is the meteorological term for radiant solar energy intercepted and received by Earth's surface?
qh: पृथ्वी की सतह द्वारा प्राप्त सौर ऊर्जा विकिरण को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Suraj se aane wali auraj (energy) ko jo bhoomi ki satah tak pahunchti hai aur yahan receive hoti hai, use tapmai ya insolation (Incoming Solar Radiation) kehte hain. Ye akshar 'incoming solar radiation' ka short form hai. Yahan se kuch hissa wapas reflect hota hai (albedo), kuch bhoomi sokhti hai aur kuch infrared ban kar wapas nikalta hai (terrestrial reradiation). Geothermal flux bhoomi ke andar se aane wali garmi hai. Exam point: India mein sabse zyada insolation April-March ke Rajasthan mein milti hai; insolation 90 degree par sabse tez hoti hai.

qe: What dynamic meteorological trigger drives the onset of the Indian Summer (South-West) Monsoon?
qh: भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप में ग्रीष्मकालीन (दक्षिण-पश्चिम) मानसून पवनों के आगमन का प्राथमिक प्रेरक क्या है?
o: Thermal high-pressure cell over the Tibetan Plateau
Intense continental heating creating a deep monsoon trough over northwest India and the Gangetic plain
Warm ocean currents flowing toward Antarctica
e: Bharat mai dakshin-pashchim monsoon ki shuruat ka mukhya kaaran uttar-pashchim Bharat aur Ganga ke mamle (plain) mein bahut gehri monsoon trough (mandak dabaav ki patti) banna hai. Garmi ke mahino mein yahan zameen tez garam hoti hai aur dabaav bahut gir jaata hai; isi mandak ki taraf Bay of Bengal aur Arabian Sea se naam hawaayein khinchi chali aati hain. Tibetan Plateau ka garam hona upari hawa ka bahav banata hai jo is paripatra ko mazbooti deta hai. Polar hawaayein ya Antarctica ki taraf jaane wali garm dhara nirnayak nahi hain. Exam point: monsoon = mausami hawa ka badlav, 'thermal low' aur ITCZ ke sarakne se juda hua.

qe: The post-monsoon transition condition known as 'October Heat' in India is caused by:
qh: भारत में 'अक्टूबर हीट' (क्वार की उमस) की मौसमी दशा किसके कारण उत्पन्न होती है?
o: Frequent snow flurries in northern valleys
Clear post-monsoon skies, lingering soil moisture, and high humidity creating oppressive heat
e: Monsoon ke jaane ke baad October mein aakash saaf ho jaata hai aur zameen mein abhi bhi barsaat ka paani aur naamta bacha rehta hai. Saaf aakash se suraj ki garmi bina rukavat ke zameen par padti hai, lekin naamta ki wajah se pasina kam nahi hota (evaporation rukta hai) - isse october heat kehte hain. Isi naamta aur garmi ke karan October mein Bengal aur Odisha ke aas-paas cyclone bhi bante hain. Katabatic hawa (dhruvi thandi hawa) ya barf giri is mausam ki visheshta nahi hai. Exam point: October heat = 'saaf aakash + zameen ki naamta + uchcha tapman'.

qe: What is the standard meteorological distinction between 'Weather' and 'Climate'?
qh: 'मौसम' (Weather) और 'जलवायु' (Climate) के बीच बुनियादी वैज्ञानिक अंतर क्या है?
o: Weather is the atmospheric state at a specific instant; Climate is the composite statistical average over decades (typically 30+ years)
Weather excludes humidity and rain; Climate measures only temperature
Weather refers to historical averages; Climate measures daily changes
e: Weather (mausam) aur Climate (jalvaayu) do alag cheezein hain. Weather ek nishchit sthaan par kuch ghanton ya din bhar ki hawa ki sthiti hai - jaise aaj dopahar garmi, shaam ko baarish. Climate us sthaan ka decades (vyavharik roop se 30 saal ya usse zyada) ka average aur badlav ka pattern hai. Isliye 'aaj mausam garm hai' weather hai, lekin 'Rajasthan registan hai' climate hai. Dono ko ek hi samjhana galat hai, aur climate sirf temperature ka naam nahi, barsaat aur naamta sab shamil hai. Exam point: WMO ke anusar 30 saal ka average = climate.

qe: Which of the following geographical attributes is NOT considered a primary macro-climatic control?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कारक किसी स्थान के वृहद जलवायु नियंत्रणों में शामिल नहीं है?
e: Jalvaayu (climate) ke mukhya niyantran (controls) hote hain - bharatvritt (latitude), unchaai (altitude), samudar se duri (continentality), pawan ki disha, samundar ki dharaayein aur bhoomi ki avastha (relief). Inmein se koi bhi ek tatv tapman ya barsaat ko seedha badal deta hai. Standard Meridian Longitude sirf samay (time) tay karne ke liye apnayi gayi ek kalpana hai (82 degree 30 minute East) - ye kisi jagah ke tapman, barsaat ya hawa par koi asar nahi daalti. Isliye ye macro-climatic control nahi hai. Exam point: climate ke 6 controls - latitude, altitude, continentality, pawan, dharaayein, relief; longitude sirf samay ke liye hai.

qe: How does average annual monsoon rainfall vary across the northern Indo-Gangetic Plains?
qh: भारत के उत्तरी गंगा के मैदानों में पूर्व से पश्चिम की ओर जाने पर सामान्यतः वर्षा की मात्रा पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ता है?
o: It decreases progressively from East to West
It increases northward toward the Thar Desert
It stays uniform across all states
It increases progressively from West to East
e: Ganga ke mamle (plain) mein barsaat poorv se pashchim ki ore kam hoti hai. Iska kaaran hai ki monsoon ki dono shakhaayein (Arabian Sea aur Bay of Bengal) pehle poorv Bharat mein pravesh karti hain aur bhaari barsaat karati hain; pashchim jaane par hawa mein naamta kam hoti jaati hai. Isliye Kolkata-Bangladesh ke aas-paas 150-200 cm aur Delhi-Haryana ke aas-paas sirf 60-70 cm barish hoti hai. Uttar ki taraf Thar ki ore badhne par bhi barsaat ghatti hai. Exam point: Purvanchal mein sabse zyada, Punjab-Haryana mein sabse kam - yehi line yaad rakho.

qe: Which branch of physical geography analyzes spatial patterns of long-term climatic belts and atmosphere systems?
qh: भौगोलिक विज्ञान की कौन सी शाखा दीर्घकालिक जलवायु प्रारूपों और वायुमंडलीय प्रणालियों का अध्ययन करती है?
e: Jalvaayuki (climatology) bhautik bhugol ki wo shakha hai jo vayumandal ke lambe samay ka tapman, dabaav, hawa, barsaat jaise tatvon ke kshetriya (spatial) vitran aur unke kateebandhon (belt) ka adhyayan karti hai. Oceanography samundar ka, geomorphology bhoomi ki satah aur dhalano ka, aur hydrology paani ke chakra tatha nadiyon ka adhyayan karti hai. Isliye jalvaayu ke kateebandhon aur parighadanon ka adhyayan climatology mein hota hai. Exam point: climate = 30 saal ka average; climatology = usi ka vigyanik adhyayan.

qe: Which planetary gases predominated in Earth's primordial atmosphere prior to dissipation by solar winds?
qh: सौर पवनों द्वारा हटाए जाने से पूर्व पृथ्वी के आदि-वायुमंडल में कौन सी गैसें सर्वाधिक प्रचुर थीं?
e: Prithvi ke janm ke samay, lagbhag 4.6 arab saal pehle, vayumandal mein Hydrogen aur Helium jaisi halki gaisein sabse zyada thi. Lekin chhote aakaar (small size) ke is planet ka gravity itna kamzor tha ki ye halki gaisein suraj ki pawan (solar wind) ke jhakkon se ur kar chali gayi. Isi wajah se aaj ki vayu mein oxygen aur nitrogen jaise bhaari gaseski prabhutva hai. Kepler telescope ne aise hi primordial atmospheres wale planets dhoonde hain. Exam point: pehla atmofayer = H + He (khoya), doosra = volcanic gases, teesra = photosynthesis se aaya oxygen.

qe: What is the third most abundant gas by volume in Earth's dry atmosphere?
qh: पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल में तीसरी सर्वाधिक प्रचुर गैस कौन सी है?
e: Shushk (dry) hawa mein Nitrogen 78% aur Oxygen 21% ke baad sabse zyada hissa Argon ka hai - lagbhag 0.93%. Argon ek nishkriya (inert) aur bhaari gas hai, isliye ye bulb aur tube light bharte samay istemal hoti hai. Carbon Dioxide sirf 0.04% hai, Neon aur Methane part per million (bahut kam) matra mein hain. Isliye 'teesra sabse zyada' ka sahi jawab Argon hai. Exam point: order - Nitrogen (1), Oxygen (2), Argon (3), Carbon Dioxide (4).

qe: Why is Venus the hottest planet in the Solar System despite Mercury being closer to the Sun?
qh: सूर्य के अधिक निकट न होने के बावजूद शुक्र हमारे सौरमंडल का सबसे गर्म ग्रह क्यों है?
o: Runaway greenhouse effect created by a dense atmosphere composed of over 95% CO2
e: Shukra (Venus) suraj se door hone ke baawjood sabse garam grah hai kyunki uske vayumandal mein 95% se zyada Carbon Dioxide ki ghana parat hai. Ye CO2 bhoomi se nikalne wali garmi ko jaane nahi deti aur wapas bhej deti hai - ise runaway greenhouse effect kehte hain. Iska nateeja ye hai ki uski satah ka tapman lagbhag 465 degree C hai jo Budh (Mercury) se bhi zyada hai. Radioactive decay sirf andar ki garmi deta hai, tidal locking poori tarah nahi hua hai, aur tectonic plates ka na hona iska main kaaran nahi hai. Exam point: Venus = ghanna CO2 vayumandal = sabse garam grah.

qe: Which volcanic outgassing product condensed during planetary cooling to form Earth's early oceans?
qh: पृथ्वी के शीतलन के समय ज्वालामुखीय डीगैसिंग (Degassing) से निकला कौन सा घटक संघनित होकर महासागरों का आधार बना?
e: Prithvi ke janm ke baad jab satah dheere-dheere thandi hone lagi, tab jwalamukhi (volcano) se nikle jalvaashp (water vapour) ne sanghanit (condense) hokar baarish ki. Karodon saal tak hui is ashadharan (continuous) barsaat ne dhansi (depression) ilaakon ko bhar diya aur 'prithvi ke prathmik samudra' ban gaye. Liquid oxygen aur molten silica is prakriya mein nahi bante, aur sulphur dioxide ek jaharili gas hai. Isliye samudra ke paani ka mool strot jalvaashp hi hai. Exam point: hydrated minerals ke roop mein paani prithvi ke andar hi tha - baad mein jwalamukhi se bahar aaya.

qe: Which evolutionary biological process elevated free molecular oxygen levels in Earth's secondary atmosphere?
qh: पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल में आणविक ऑक्सीजन की सांद्रता बढ़ाने के लिए कौन सी जैविक प्रक्रिया जिम्मेदार रही?
e: Prithvi ke doosre vayumandal mein oxygen ki matra bahut kam thi. Lagbhag 2.4 arab saal pehle cyanobacteria ne oxygenic photosynthesis (suchan-le sansleshan) shuru kiya, jismein suraj ki roshni aur CO2 se khana banate samay Oxygen gas chhodti hai. Isi 'Great Oxidation Event' ne mukta oxygen ki matra badha di jo aage chal kar ozone layer bana kar jeevan ko surakshit kar saki. Chemosynthesis (rasayan sansleshan) bina roshni ke hoti hai aur oxygen nahi deti, fermentation aur cellular respiration oxygen ka upbhog karte hain. Exam point: oxygen ka asli strot = cyanobacteria ka photosynthesis.

qe: What seasonal distinction characterizes India's 'Rabi' and 'Kharif' agricultural cycles?
qh: भारत के 'रबी' और 'खरीफ' फसल चक्रों में प्राथमिक मौसमी अंतर क्या है?
o: Kharif is sown with the onset of the southwest monsoon; Rabi is sown in autumn/winter and harvested in spring
Rabi is sown during the summer monsoon; Kharif in winter frosts
Both share the exact same sowing and harvest calendar
Rabi crops require swamp irrigation; Kharif crops grow on dry plateaus only
e: Kharif ki fasalein monsoon shuru hone par (June-July) boyi jaati hain aur October mein kati jaati hain - jaise dhaan, makka, jwar, bajra, kapas, jute. Rabi ki fasalein October-Novenber mein boyi jaati hain (thandi ke samay) aur March-April mein kati jaati hain - jaise gehum, jau, matar, sarson. Zaid ek teesra, chhota mausam hai (March-June) mein tarbooz, kheera, moong jaisi fasalein. Isliye Kharif = monsoon kal, Rabi = thandi kal. Exam point: Rabi fasalein thandi jalvaayu aur paush (frost) maangti hain, lekin bahut adhik thand se unki fasal kharab ho sakti hai.

qe: What characterizes the climatic phenomenon of 'Continentality'?
qh: जलवायु के संदर्भ में 'महाद्वीपीयता' (Continentality) प्रभाव की मुख्य विशेषता क्या है?
o: Extreme annual and diurnal temperature ranges with hot summers and cold winters due to distance from oceans
e: Continentality ka matlab hai samundar se doori ka asar. Samundar tapman ko santulit (moderate) rakhta hai - garam mein thanda aur thande mein garam. Samundar se door ilaakon mein ye sanmantrak (regulator) nahi hota, isliye garmiyan bahut garam aur thandiyan bahut thandi hoti hain. Yahi wajah hai ki Punjab-Delhi mein 45 degree C ki garmi aur 4 degree C ki thand dono padti hain, jabki Mumbai mein tapman kam antar dikhata hai. Isliye mausmi hawa ka na hona ya samudri saltalta iska matlab nahi hai. Exam point: continentality = tapman ka sabse bada vaarshik aur dainik antar, samundar se doori ke karan.

qe: In which geological period did the supercontinent Pangaea initiate its breakup into Laurasia and Gondwanaland?
qh: किस भूवैज्ञानिक काल में पंजिया महामहाद्वीप का विभाजन लारेशिया और गोंडवाना लैंड में प्रारंभ हुआ था?
e: Pangaea supercontinent lagbhag 200-180 million saal pehle Triassic se Jurassic kaal mein tootna shuru hua. Ye pehle do bade bhaagon mein bata - uttar mein Laurasia (Angara-land) aur dakshin mein Gondwanaland. Isi vichchedan (rifting) se Atlantic Ocean ka naya basin bana aur India ka alag safar shuru hua. Carboniferous mein koyal ke zamane ke jungle the lekin Pangaea ka breakup nahi hua tha, Tertiary aur Quaternary kaal to bhautik jeevan ka kaal hai. Exam point: Pangaea ka tootna = Triassic-Jurassic; iske baad Laurasia aur Gondwana bhi aage toote.

qe: The Red Sea represents which tectonic plate boundary stage in the Wilson Cycle?
qh: 'लाल सागर' प्लेट विवर्तनिकी के संदर्भ में किस भूवैज्ञानिक अवस्था का उदाहरण है?
o: A nascent or juvenile ocean basin formed by active continental rifting
e: Lal Sagar (Red Sea) ek naya yuva samudri basin hai jo Africa aur Arabian plate ke alag hone (rifting) se bana hai. Yahi Wilson Cycle ki pehli avastha hai jismein khamandal (continent) phatta hai, ek rift valley banta hai, phir wo bhar kar samudra ban jaata hai - isliye ise adolescent ya nascent ocean kehte hain. Subduction zone ka deep trench iska ulta hai (purana samudra khatam hona), aur transform fault mein plate ek doosre ko ragad-te hain. Exam point: Red Sea = future naya samudra; East African Rift = aage chal kar isi ka pehla charan.

qe: The supercontinent Pangaea broke into which northern and southern macro-landmasses?
qh: पंजिया महामहाद्वीप किन दो प्रमुख उत्तरी और दक्षिणी भू-भागों में विभाजित हुआ था?
o: Laurasia in the north and Gondwanaland in the south
e: Pangaea lagbhag 200 million saal pehle do hisson mein bata - uttar mein Laurasia (aaj ka North America, Greenland aur Eurasia) aur dakshin mein Gondwanaland (South America, Africa, India, Australia aur Antarctica). In dono ke beech mein Tethys Sea ka samudri chanv (seaway) tha jo Alps aur Himalaya ke bante samay band ho gaya. Eurasia, Oceania, Laurentia ya Baltica alag naam hain lekin Pangaea ke pehle bade vichchedan ke do hisse yahi hai. Exam point: North mein Laurasia, South mein Gondwana - do naam yaad rakho.

qe: The geomorphic term 'Karst' topography is derived from a limestone plateau along which body of water?
qh: 'कास्ट' (Karst) स्थलाकृति का नाम किस क्षेत्र के चूना पत्थर पठार से लिया गया है?
o: Adriatic Sea coast in the Dinaric Alps (Balkan region)
e: Karst ek aisi bhoomi-rachana hai jo limestone (chuna patthar) ke paani mein ghulne se banti hai, jismein gaar (cave), sot (sinkhole), polje aur stalactite-stalagmite banate hain. Iska naam Adriatic Sea ke kinare Dinaric Alps (Balkan) ke plateau se aaya hai, jahan pehle is tarah ki topograph ka adhyayan hua. Baltic, Biscay ya Caspian se iska na koi sambandh hai. Exam point: India mein karst - Meghalaya (Mawsmai, Krem Liat Prah), Borra caves (Andhra), aur Himalaya ke karst ilaake.

qe: In paleogeography, what was the 'Tethys Sea'?
qh: भूवैज्ञानिक इतिहास में 'टेथिस सागर' क्या था?
o: An east-west oceanic seaway separating northern Laurasia from southern Gondwanaland
A landlocked glacial lake in Siberia
A rift valley inside the African continent
e: Tethys ek lamba east-west samudri dvar (seaway) tha jo uttar ke Laurasia aur dakshin ke Gondwanaland ke beech faila tha. Jab India ne Asia se takra kar Himalaya banaye, ye samudra dhans gaya (uska naam ab sirf Mediterranean mein bacha). Isi samundar ke andar dariyo waale pale (sediment) poore Himalaya ka chuna patthar ban gaye. Siberia ki jheel, Antarctica ka samudra ya Africa ki rift valley is varnan se match nahi karte. Exam point: Tethys = do supercontinents ke beech ka samudra; isi ke nasht hone se Himalaya bana.

qe: What name did Alfred Wegener give to the universal super-ocean surrounding Pangaea?
qh: अल्फ्रेड वेगनर ने पंजिया को घेरने वाले विशाल आदिम महासागर को क्या नाम दिया था?
e: Alfred Wegener ne apne 1912 ke sidhanth mein bataya ki saare mahadeep ek hi bade bhoomi-pind Pangaea mein jude the, aur uske charon taraf ek hi vishaal samudra tha jiska naam unhone Panthalassa rakha. Jab Pangaea toota, to ye bhi banta gaya. Iapetus ek purana samudra tha jo Laurentia aur Baltica ke beech tha (Atlantic banne se pehle), Tethys do supercontinents ke beech ka samudra tha, aur Poseidon ek Greek devta hai. Exam point: Panthalassa = Pangaea ko ghere hue ek hi maha-samudra, jo aaj ke Pacific ka purvaj maana jaata hai.

qe: The ancient supercontinental landmass 'Gondwanaland' was named by Eduard Suess after a tribe from which region?
qh: 'गोंडवाना लैंड' का नाम किस क्षेत्र की प्रसिद्ध जनजाति के नाम पर रखा गया था?
e: Gondwanaland ka naam Austriayi vaigyanik Eduard Suess ne rakha tha, unke anusar ye naam Central India ke 'Gond' janjati se alag hai, jahan is prachin bhoomi-khand ke avshesh (fossils) aur pathar milte hain. Isi wajah se Kalahari, Amazon ya Australia galat hai. Aaj bhi Gondwana ka naam Gondwana coal, Gondwana rocks aur Gondwana University ke roop mein Bharat mein milta hai. Exam point: Gondwanaland ka naam Central India ke Gond tribe se aaya, aur ye ek dakshin mahadeep (southern supercontinent) tha.

qe: The 'Great Dividing Range' is the principal mountain system of which continent?
qh: 'ग्रेट डिवाइडिंग रेंज' किस महाद्वीप की प्रमुख पर्वत श्रृंखला है?
e: Great Dividing Range Australia ka sabse bada parvat samuh hai jo Queensland se lekar Victoria aur New South Wales tak country ke poorvi tat (east coast) ke saath lagbhag 3500 km tak faila hua hai. Ismein Australia ki sabse unchi choti Mount Kosciuszko (2228 m) hai. Iske pashchim Australia ka vishaal sookha antarvarti (outback) hai. Europe ka Alps-Ural, Africa ka Atlas-Drakensberg aur South America ka Andes alag mahadeepon ke parvat hain. Exam point: Australia ka mukhya parvat = Great Dividing Range, jo poorvi tat ke saath-saath chalta hai aur barish ko rok kar andar ko sookha rakhta hai.

qe: Which major southern continents and subcontinents originated from the fragmentation of Gondwanaland?
qh: गोंडवाना लैंड के विखंडन से निम्नलिखित में से किन भू-भागों का निर्माण हुआ?
o: South America, Africa, Peninsular India, Australia, and Antarctica
e: Gondwanaland ke tootne se lagbhag 180 million saal pehle kai bhumi-blocks alag hue - South America, Africa, Madagascar, Peninsular India, Arabia, Australia aur Antarctica. Yahi sab aaj ke dakshin golaardh ke mahadeep aur upamahadeep hain. North America, Greenland aur Eurasia Laurasia ke hisse the, Britain-Europe bhi Laurasia mein the, aur Scandinavia-Siberia-Japan aaj ke uttar ke bhoomi-khand hain. Exam point: Gondwana ke 5 mukhya ansh - South America, Africa, Peninsular India, Australia, Antarctica.

qe: Which planet is termed 'Earth's Twin' because of comparable mass, radius, and density?
qh: समान आकार, व्यास और द्रव्यमान के कारण किस ग्रह को 'पृथ्वी का जुड़वां ग्रह' कहा जाता है?
e: Shukra (Venus) ko 'Prithvi ka judwa' (Earth's Twin) kehte hain kyunki uska aakaar, bhaar (mass), ghannatva (density) aur gurutvakarshan lagbhag prithvi ke barabar hai. Iska diameter lagbhag 12,104 km hai (prithvi 12,742 km) aur dono ke andar ka bhautik sanghatan bhi milta hai. Lekin uska vayumandal CO2 se bhara hai isliye wahan zindagi sambhav nahi. Mangal (Mars) chhota aur patla hai, Neptune gas giant hai, Budh (Mercury) chhota aur bagair vayu hai. Exam point: Venus = Earth's Twin (aakaar), lekin sabse garam grah.

qe: The principal Asteroid Belt in our solar system orbits between which two planetary tracks?
qh: हमारे सौरमंडल में मुख्य 'क्षुद्रग्रह पट्टी' (Asteroid Belt) किन दो ग्रहों की कक्षाओं के मध्य स्थित है?
e: Asteroid Belt (Kshudragrah patti) Mangal (Mars) aur Brahspati (Jupiter) ke beech faili hui hai. Yahan hazaron chhote-chhote pathre chakkar kaat-te hain, jinhe asteroid kehte hain; inmein se sabse bada Ceres hai jo ab 'bona grah' (dwarf planet) maana jaata hai. Ye patti Mangal aur Brahspati ke beech isliye bani kyunki Brahspati ke bhaari gurutvakarshan ne yahan ek grah banne nahi diya. Jupiter-Saturn, Venus-Earth ya Earth-Mars ke beech aisi koi patti nahi hai. Exam point: asteroid belt = Mars aur Jupiter ke beech; Krai (Kuiper) belt Neptune ke aage hai.

qe: In which country is Christmas celebrated during mid-summer due to its Southern Hemisphere location?
qh: दक्षिणी गोलार्ध में स्थित होने के कारण किस देश में क्रिसमस ग्रीष्म ऋतु में मनाया जाता है?
e: Australia dakshin golaardh (Southern Hemisphere) mein hai, isliye jab uttar golaardh mein December mein sardiyan hoti hain, wahan garmiyan hoti hain. Isliye Australia mein Christmas December ki garmiyon mein hoti hai - log beach par jate hain aur 'Christmas in July' karne wale bhi hote hain. Britain, Norway aur Canada sab uttar golaardh mein hain, jahan December mein thand aur barf hoti hai. Exam point: golaardh (hemisphere) ke anusar mausam ulta hota hai - ye festivals aur crops dono par lagu hota hai.

qe: Which continent is the largest by land area, containing roughly 30% of Earth's total land surface?
qh: पृथ्वी का सबसे बड़ा महाद्वीप कौन सा है, जो कुल भूमि क्षेत्रफल का लगभग 30% हिस्सा कवर करता है?
e: Asia duniya ka sabse bada mahadeep hai, jiska kshetrafal (area) lagbhag 4.5 crore square km hai - ye duniya ki kul bhoomi ka 30% aur aabadi ka 60% hissa hai. Ismein Himalaya, Gobi registan, Siberia ka thand aur Ganga-Brahmaputra ka maidan sab aata hai. Africa (20%) doosra, North America teesra aur Europe chhota hai. Antarctica barf se dhaka ek alag mahadeep hai. Exam point: Asia - kshetra (area) mein sabse bada, aabadi mein sabse zyada; Bharat Asia ke dakshin mein sthit hai.

qe: Which landmass is called the 'Island Continent' because it is entirely ocean-bounded?
qh: चारों ओर से महासागरों और सागरों से घिरे होने के कारण किस महाद्वीप को 'द्वीपीय महाद्वीप' कहा जाता है?
e: Australia ko 'Island Continent' (Dweep Mahadeep) kehte hain kyunki ye duniya ka sabse chhota mahadeep hai aur charon taraf se samundar se ghira hua hai. Isi wajah se yahan koi doosra desh ya bhoomi nahi milti (New Zealand aur Papua New Guinea alag hain). Antarctica bhi samundar se ghira hai lekin uski ginti mahadeep ke roop mein alag se hoti hai aur wahan koi sthayi aabadi nahi. Greenland sabse bada dweep hai lekin wo poori tarah ek island hai, continent nahi. Exam point: Australia = smallest continent + island continent dono.

qe: The dense tropical rainforest of the Amazon Basin lies primarily within which latitudinal zone?
qh: 'अमेज़न बेसिन' के घने वर्षावन मुख्य रूप से किस अक्षांशीय जलवायु क्षेत्र में स्थित हैं?
e: Amazon ka Ghana Van (rainforest) lagbhag 10 degree north se 10 degree south bharatvritt ke beech faila hua hai, jise Equatorial Zone ya Ushn Kateebandh kehte hain (yani bhoomi-madhya rekha ke dono taraf ka garam kateebandh, 0 se 10 degree tak). Yahan poore saal 25 degree C se zyada tapman aur 200 cm se zyada barsaat hoti hai, isliye poori tarah haryali rehti hai aur duniya ki sabse zyada jaivik vividhta (biodiversity) yahin milti hai. Temperate zone thanda hota hai, sub-tropical arid registan ki peti hai, aur tundra barfila region hai. Exam point: Amazon = equatorial Ghana van = saal bhar barsaat aur uchcha tapman, isliye ise 'duniya ke phephde' (lungs of the world) kehte hain.

qe: Which river is widely recognized as the longest in the world, traversing northeastern Africa?
qh: पूर्वोत्तर अफ्रीका से होकर बहने वाली विश्व की सबसे लंबी नदी कौन सी है?
e: Nile nadi ko aam taur par duniya ki sabse lambi nadi maana jaata hai - iski lambai lagbhag 6650 km hai. Ye Africa ke Uganda-Burundi se nikal kar Sudan, Egypt se hokar Mediterranean Sea mein girti hai. Amazon paani ki matra (discharge) mein sabse badi hai, lekin lambai mein Nile aage hai. Congo chhoti hai, aur Mississippi-Missouri North America mein hai. Exam point: lambai = Nile (6650 km), jal-matr = Amazon; dono ke beech ka antar yaad rakho.

qe: Approximately how many days does the Moon take to complete one sidereal orbit around Earth?
qh: चंद्रमा को पृथ्वी की एक परिक्रमा पूरी करने में लगभग कितना समय लगता है?
e: Chandrama (Moon) prithvi ka ek chakkar siderial (taaron ke hisaab se) 27.3 din mein lagata hai. Isi karan ye har din lagbhag 50 minute der se nikalta hai. Lekin ek hi jal (new moon) se doosre jal tak 29.5 din lagte hain - ise synodic month kehte hain, kyunki is beech prithvi bhi suraj ke around chal chuki hoti hai. 24 ghante prithvi ka ek din hai, 365 din prithvi ka ek saal. Exam point: 27.3 din = sidereal (taaron ke hisaab se), 29.5 din = synodic (jal ke hisaab se).

qe: The 'Dasht-e Lut' salt desert, known for extreme land surface temperatures, is located in:
qh: 'दश्त-ए लुट' लवण मरुस्थल किस देश में स्थित है?
e: Dasht-e Lut ek khari (salty) registan hai jo Iran ke dakshin-poorv hisse mein hai aur duniya ki sabse garam satah maani jaati hai - yahan 70 degree C tak tapman record hua hai. Isi karan ise 'Thermal Pole of Earth' bhi kehte hain. Saudi Arabia mein Rub al Khali, Pakistan mein Thar aur Iraq mein al-Jazira ke registan hain, lekin Dasht-e Lut unme se koi nahi. Exam point: Dasht-e Lut aur Dasht-e Kavir Iran ke do bade registan hain; Iran ke plateau par hamun (endorheic) jheelein bhi hain.

qe: What physical evidence did Alfred Wegener cite as the 'Jigsaw Fit' across the South Atlantic?
qh: अल्फ्रेड वेगनर ने दक्षिण अटलांटिक के आर-पार किस भौगोलिक साक्ष्य को 'जिग-सॉ फिट' के रूप में प्रस्तुत किया था?
o: The alignment of Sri Lanka and India
The complementary fit between the Atlantic coastlines of South America (Brazil) and West Africa (Gulf of Guinea)
Coastlines of North America and Australia
The matching slopes of Madagascar and Antarctica
e: Alfred Wegener ne sabse pehle ye dikhaya ki Atlantic Mahasagar ke dono taraf ke tat (coastline) ek doosre ke saath match karte hain - South America ke Brazil ka ubharta (bulge) hua tat Africa ke Gulf of Guinea ke dhansi (dip) se lagbhag milta hai. Isi ko Jigsaw Fit ya Fit of the Continents kehte hain. Iske saath unhone wahi fossiles aur wahi pathar ke bhandar dono taraf hone ka pramaan bhi diya. Sri Lanka, Madagascar ya Australia se ye tulna galat hai. Exam point: Wegener ke 4 pramaan - Jigsaw fit, fossils, rocks, aur Tilley (glacial) nishaan.

qe: In which ocean basin is the longest continuous submarine volcanic mountain system, the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, located?
qh: प्रसिद्ध मध्य-महासागरीय कटक (Mid-Oceanic Ridge) किस महासागर के मध्य फैली एक प्रमुख पर्वत श्रृंखला है?
e: Mid-Atlantic Ridge duniya ka sabse lamba samudri parvat samuh (submarine mountain system) hai jo Atlantic Ocean ke beech mein uttar se dakshin tak lagbhag 16000 km tak faila hua hai. Ye ek divergent (faile hue) plate boundary hai jahan Eurasia-Africa aur Americas ke plates ek doosre se door ja rahe hain aur naya samudri bhoomi-bhag (sea floor) ban raha hai. Isi karan yahan lava nikalta hai, jisse Surtsey jaisa naya dweep (Iceland ke paas 1963) bana. Pacific ka East Pacific Rise, Indian Ocean ka Carlsberg-Chagos Ridge isse alag hain. Exam point: sea floor spreading ka proof - Mid-Atlantic Ridge.

qe: In what wetland soil ecosystem is 'Makhana' (Euryale ferox) traditionally cultivated in north Bihar?
qh: बिहार में 'मखाना' (Fox Nut) की खेती मुख्य रूप से किस प्रकार के जलीय/मृदा क्षेत्र में की जाती है?
e: Makhana (Euryale ferox), jise fox nut bhi kehte hain, uttar Bihar ke chaur aur maun naamak daldal (wetland) mein ugaya jaata hai - khaas kar Darbhanga, Madhubani, Saharsa, Supaul, Katihar ilaake mein. Ye kaanta (thorny) paudha hai jo daldal ke paani mein u-gta hai aur iske beej (seed) ko sukha kar bhun kar khaya jaata hai. Makhana Bihar ka GI product hai aur bharat ka 80-90% makhana yahin se aata hai. Registan, coastal saline marsh ya laterite dhalan iska sthaan nahi. Exam point: Makhana = Bihar ka Darbhanga/Mithilanchal ka chaur wetland ka 'brown gold'.

qe: Which soil order is internationally celebrated as ideal for cotton cultivation due to high clay content and moisture retention?
qh: उच्च नमी धारण क्षमता और चिकनी बनावट के कारण कौन सी मिट्टी कपास की खेती के लिए सर्वोत्तम मानी जाती है?
e: Kali (Regur) mitti ko kapas ki fasal ke liye sabse behtar maana jaata hai kyunki ismein chikni mati (clay) zyada hoti hai jo naamta (moisture) lambe samay tak rok leti hai, aur monsoon ke baad bhi zameen mein nami bani rehti hai. Iski rang kali ya bhoori-bhaari hoti hai aur ye basalt (jwalamukhi pathar) ke tutne se banti hai - isse Deccan Trap ke ilaake mein sabse zyada milti hai - Maharashtra, MP, Gujarat. Laterite mitti kam upjaau hoti hai, alluvial bahut upjaau hai lekin kapas ke liye regur behtar hai, red soil iron oxide wali hai. Exam point: Regur (black soil) = cotton + self-ploughing + high moisture holding.

qe: Which Indian state is the single largest producer of plantation tea, contributing over 50% of national production?
qh: भारत का कौन सा राज्य देश के 50% से अधिक चाय उत्पादन के साथ शीर्ष पर है?
e: Assam bharat ka sabse bada chai (tea) utpadak rajya hai, jo desh ki kul chai ka lagbhag 55% deta hai aur duniya ka lagbhag 13-14% bhi. Brahmaputra ki ghati (valley) ki bhaari barish, uchcha naamta aur jalua (alluvial) mitti chai ke liye aadarsh hai. West Bengal (Darjeeling, Dooars) doosra sabse bada hai, Kerala aur Tamil Nadu dakshin ke chhote utpadak hain. Exam point: chai ke top 2 rajya - Assam (brahmaputra valley) aur West Bengal; arabica/robusta coffee Karnataka ka.

qe: Which Indian state accounts for approximately 70% of total domestic coffee production?
qh: भारत के कुल कॉफी उत्पादन का लगभग 70% हिस्सा किस राज्य से आता है?
e: Karnataka bharat ka sabse bada coffee utpadak rajya hai, jo desh ki kho-bi ki lagbhag 70% fasal deta hai - khaas kar Kodagu (Coorg), Chikkamagaluru aur Hassan ke pahaadi ilaake. Yahan ki unchai, chhaya (shade trees) aur monsoon ka mausam coffee ke liye best hai. Kerala lagbhag 20% aur Tamil Nadu (Nilgiri) lagbhag 5% deta hai, Andhra Pradesh bahut chhota utpadak hai. Arabica ki tulna mein India zyada tar robusta variety ugata hai. Exam point: coffee = Karnataka (Kodagu 'coffee capital of India').

qe: Why are Indian Vertisols (Black soils) described as possessing 'self-ploughing' characteristics?
qh: 'काली मिट्टी' को 'स्व-जुताई' (Self-ploughing) वाली मिट्टी क्यों कहा जाता है?
o: They do not require tilling tools
They remain liquid throughout the rainy season
They shrink and develop wide, deep vertical cracks upon drying, facilitating natural aeration and soil mixing
e: Kali (Regur) mitti mein montmorillonite naam ka chikni mineral zyada hota hai jo naamta milne par phoolta hai aur sookhne par sangat (contract) hota hai. Isi sikudne se zameen mein gehri-chaudi karak (crack) ban jaati hain, jisse hawa andar jaati hai (aeration) aur upar ki upjaau mitti neeche chali jaati hai - isi ko 'self-ploughing' ya self-mulching kehte hain. Isi liye kisan ko baar-baar hal chalane ki zaroorat kam padti hai. Ye mitti keval tractor ya hathyar ki kami se self-ploughing nahi kehlati, aur regur paani mein chipku (sticky) hoti hai lekin poore mausam taral (liquid) nahi rehti. Exam point: regur ki pehchan = gehri cracks + self-ploughing.

qe: Which Indian union territory is renowned for saffron cultivation on ancient lacustrine 'Karewa' terraces?
qh: प्राचीन हिमनदीय झीलीय निक्षेपों 'करेवा' (Karewas) पर केसर की खेती के लिए कौन सा क्षेत्र प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Kashmir ki Karewa mitti ek lacustrine (jheel mein jama hui) talchat (deposit) hai jo purani jheel sookhne se bani. Ismein potash aur chuna (lime) zyada hota hai, magar nitrogen kam, aur paani nikalne ki chamta (drainage) achhi hai - isi liye yahan kesar (saffron) ugaya jaata hai. Pampore ka ilaaka 'saffron town' hai aur ye bharat ka sabse bada kesar utpadak hai. Himachal, Sikkim ya Uttarakhand ka mausam kesar ke liye itna anukool nahi. Exam point: Karewa = lacustrine terrace + saffron; ismein almond, apple aur zafran dono ugte hain.

qe: How do xerophytic desert plants morphologically minimize transpiration water loss?
qh: मरुस्थलीय पौधे (Xerophytes) वाष्पोत्सर्जन द्वारा जल हानि को कम करने के लिए क्या रूपात्मक बदलाव करते हैं?
o: Reducing leaves into thorns, developing thick waxy cuticles, and sunken stomata
Growing exclusively as floating aquatic weeds
e: Registan ke paudhe (xerophytes) ke paas paani bachane ke sabhi upay hote hain. Patte chhote, mote aur kaanton (thorns) mein badal jaate hain jisse transpiration (pasina) kam ho; upar ek mota mom (waxy cuticle) aur patti jaisi parat ban jaati hai jo bhaap rok leti hai; stomata (paani nikalne ke chhed) patte ki gehraai mein dhase (sunken) hote hain. Isi tarah tana (stem) mota hokar paani ka koshish (storage) ban jaata hai - jaise cactus. Thin, large tender leaves ya floating aquatic weed iska ulta hai jo registan mein nahi ug sakte. Exam point: xerophyte ke 3 hathiyar - thorns, cuticle, sunken stomata.

qe: What distinguishes 'Mixed Farming' as a sustainable agricultural practice?
qh: कृषि भूगोल के संदर्भ में 'मिश्रित कृषि' (Mixed Farming) की सही परिभाषा क्या है?
o: Intercropping two different grain varieties in the same furrow
Cultivating solely without any water inputs
Simultaneous cultivation of food/fodder crops along with livestock rearing on the same holding
e: Mixed Farming mein ek hi khet (holding) par khaane ki fasal, chara (fodder) aur pashudhan (livestock) - sab saath-saath hote hain. Ye ek sanyukt (integrated) pranali hai jismein pashu ka gobar khad ban jaata hai, pashu ka doodh ya gosht aay ka srot deta hai, aur fasal ka bacha hissa chara ban jaata hai - isliye jokhim kam ho jaata hai. Intercropping do fasalein ek hi kat with (row) mein ugana hai, wo mixed farming nahi. Ek hi fasal bina paani ke ugana bhi isse alag hai. Exam point: Mixed farming = crops + livestock; Mixed cropping = ek hi khet mein ek saath 2-3 fasalein.

qe: Which Indian state became the world's first fully certified '100% Organic State'?
qh: पूरी तरह से रासायनिक उर्वरकों और कीटनाशकों को त्यागकर 100% जैविक बनने वाला भारत का पहला राज्य कौन सा है?
e: Sikkim bharat ka pehla '100% organic state' hai (2016) aur ise duniya ka pehla poori tarah jaivik rajya kaha gaya (FAO ne manaya). Usne 2010 se rasayanik khad aur keetnashak (pesticide) ka istemal ban kar diya aur 75,000 hectare kheti ko organic mein badal diya. Kerala, Punjab aur Himachal Pradesh organic kheti karte hain lekin 100% nahi. Exam point: Sikkim = organic farming ka model + 100% organic state; wahan ki mitti aur barish ki gunvatta iska aadhar hai.

qe: Which industrial cash crop requires high temperatures, moderate moisture, and at least 210 frost-free days?
qh: किस नकदी फसल के लिए उच्च तापमान, हल्की वर्षा और कम से कम 210 पाला रहित दिनों की आवश्यकता होती है?
e: Kapas (cotton) ek uchcha tapman (21-27 degree C), habag naamta aur 210 se zyada pala-mukt (frost-free) dino ki fasal hai. Iski boyi monsoon shuru hone par hoti hai aur ye regur (kali) mitti mein sabse achhi hoti hai. Frost ya pala aane par plant mar jaata hai isliye 210 dino ka mausam zaroori hai. Jute ko uchcha naamta chahiye par wo paani bhare ilaake mein ugti hai, paddy mein submerged field chahiye, aur wheat thande mausam ki fasal hai. Exam point: cotton = 'white gold', Gujarat-Maharashtra-Telangana ke Deccan trap (regur) ilaake.

qe: Why does excessive flood irrigation cause land degradation in canal-irrigated plains of Punjab and Haryana?
qh: पंजाब और हरियाणा के नहरी क्षेत्रों में अत्यधिक सिंचाई से भूमि निम्नीकरण क्यों होता है?
o: Waterlogging that induces capillary action, accumulating surface salinity and alkalinity
e: Canal se sinchai karne wale Punjab-Haryana ke maidan mein zaroorat se zyada paani dene par paani zameen ke neeche jama ho jaata hai, jise waterlogging kehte hain. Zameen ke neeche ka paani keshik (capillary) kriya se upar khichta aata hai aur saath mein apna lavan (salt) bhi le aata hai. Paani vaashpit (evaporate) ho jaata hai lekin lavan satah par jama reh jaate hain - isse mitti lavni (saline) aur kshariya (alkaline) ho jaati hai aur uspar kuchh nahi ugta. Isse 'reh' ya 'thur' naamak safed parat ban jaati hai. Mitti ka poora sookhna ya pathar ka erode hona is varnan se match nahi karte. Exam point: over-irrigation = waterlogging + salinity; sudhaar ke liye drainage, gypsum aur keshar-rahit (salt-free) fasal chakra istemal hota hai.

qe: Which non-violent grassroots movement in Tehri Garhwal revived indigenous crop varieties without agrochemicals?
qh: टिहरी गढ़वाल में रासायनिक उर्वरकों के बिना पारंपरिक बीजों और विविध फसलों को बचाने के लिए कौन सा आंदोलन चला था?
e: Beej Bachao Andolan (Save the Seeds Movement) 1980 ke dashak mein Tehri Garhwal ke Garden mein Vijay Jardhari aur kisan saathiyon ne shuru kiya tha. Iska uddeshya taja (local) beej ki variety bachana, barter ke through beej banana aur rasayanik khad-keetnashak ke bina prakrutik kheti karna tha. Silent Valley Movement Kerala ke Ghana van ko bachane ke liye tha, Appiko Movement Karnataka mein jungle kAtne ke khilaf tha, aur Narmada Bachao Andolan dam ke khilaf. Exam point: Beej Bachao Andolan = beej suraksha + paramparik kheti ka pratik.

qe: Why are millets like Jowar, Bajra, and Ragi termed 'Nutri-cereals' and climate-resilient crops?
qh: ज्वार, बाजरा और रागी जैसे मोटे अनाजों को जलवायु-अनुकूल और पोषक अनाज क्यों माना जाता है?
o: They require high chemical fertilizer doses
They grow exclusively in submerged floodplains
They offer high micronutrient density and withstand drought and poor soils with low water footprints
e: Jowar, Bajra aur Ragi jaise mota anaj (millets) mein protein, rau (iron), calcium aur fibre zyada hota hai isliye inhe 'Nutri-cereals' kaha jaata hai. Ye sookha sahan (drought tolerant) karne wale, kam paani maangne wale aur choti-kharab mitti mein bhi ugne wale hote hain - isliye ye jalvaayu ki drishti se 'climate-resilient' hain aur bharat ke samriddh (sustainable) kheti ka hissa hai. Ye rasayanik khad zyada nahi maangte, submerged floodplain ya gehre paani mein nahi ugte. Exam point: 2023 'International Year of Millets' India ke pradhan-mantri ke sujhaav par manaya gaya tha.

qe: The transformative 'White Revolution' (Operation Flood) initiated in 1970 elevated India into the top producer of:
qh: 1970 में शुरू की गई 'श्वेत क्रांति' (ऑपरेशन फ्लड) ने भारत को किस वस्तु के उत्पादन में विश्व में शीर्ष पर पहुँचाया?
e: White Revolution ke is 'Operation Flood' ki shuruat 1970 mein hui thi, jiske janmdata Dr. Verghese Kurien ko 'Father of White Revolution' kaha jaata hai. Iska lakshya tha doodh ka utpadan badhana, Amul jaise sahkari (cooperative) samuh banana aur doodh ki vitaran vyavastha sudhar'na. Isi se bharat duniya ka sabse bada doodh utpadak desh ban gaya. Rice green revolution se, sugar bhi usi ke saath, aur inland fish Blue Revolution se juda hai. Exam point: Yellow Revolution = tilhan (oilseed), Blue = machhli, White = doodh, Green = anaj; rang aur kranti ka jod yaad rakho.

qe: Which mountain peak is the highest summit situated within the undisputed territory of India?
qh: भारत में स्थित सबसे ऊँची पर्वत चोटी कौन सी है?
e: Bharat ke vishal kshetra mein sabse uncha parvat Kanchenjunga hai (8586 m) jo Nepal-Sikkim ki border par hai lekin 'vivaad-rahit bharat' (undisputed India) ke roop mein iski ginti hoti hai. Nanda Devi (7816 m) poore bharat mein sabse uncha hai jab Nepal-China ka hissa nahi gate; Kamet (7756 m) Uttarakhand mein hai. Mount Everest Nepal mein hai aur uski choti par se bharat ka koi hissa nahi. Exam point: Kanchenjunga = bharat ki sabse unchi choti + Himalaya ke teen sabse uncha pahadon mein se ek.

qe: Which mountain pass through the Great Himalayas connects Srinagar with the Ladakh plateau?
qh: महान हिमालय में स्थित कौन सा दर्रा श्रीनगर को लेह (लद्दाख) से जोड़ता है?
e: Zoji La pass Pashchim Himalaya mein hai aur ye Srinagar ko Drass-Kargil tatha Ladakh ke plateau se jodta hai. Ye Great Himalaya Range ko paar karta hai aur Srinagar-Leh Highway (NH-1) ka sabse ahem hissa hai - sardi mein barf girne par band ho jaata hai, isliye iske neeche Zojila tunnel banaya ja raha hai. Shipki La Himachal ko Tibet se, Nathu La Sikkim ko Tibet se aur Rohtang (Atal Tunnel) Manali ko Lahaul se jodta hai. Exam point: Ladakh jaane wala mukhya pass = Zoji La; Sikkim-China ka vyapar pass = Nathu La.

qe: The Himalayan orogenic belt resulted from continental collision between which two tectonic plates?
qh: 'हिमालय' पर्वतमाला का निर्माण किन दो प्रमुख टेक्टोनिक प्लेटों के अभिसरण से हुआ था?
e: Himalaya ka janm lagbhag 50-60 million saal pehle do plate ke takrav se hua. Gondwanaland ke tootne ke baad India plate north ki ore sarak kar Eurasian plate se takraya. India plate ka ghanatva zyada tha isliye wo Eurasian plate ke neeche dhans gaya, aur neeche dabe dariyo ke pale (sediments) mud kar Himalaya ki merein (fold mountains) ban gayi. Aaj bhi India plate lagbhag 5 cm per saal badh rahi hai, isliye Himalaya mein bhukamp (earthquake) aate hain. Pacific, Arabian-African ya Nazca plates se ye tulna galat hai. Exam point: Himalaya = Indian Plate + Eurasian Plate ka khamandali takrav; ye abhi bhi 'young fold' aur sakriya hai.

qe: Which peak represents the highest elevation in the Western Ghats and the entire South Indian peninsula?
qh: 'पश्चिमी घाट' और संपूर्ण प्रायद्वीपीय दक्षिण भारत की सबसे ऊँची पर्वत चोटी कौन सी है?
e: Anamudi (2695 m) Kerala ke Idukki jile mein sthit hai aur ye pashchimi Ghat kis sabse unchi choti hai tatha poore dakshin bharat ka bhi sabse uncha shikhar hai. Iska naam malayalam mein 'haathi ka sar' (elephant head) se aaya, kyunki ye haathi ke sir jaisa dikhta hai. Mahendragiri Odisha mein, Kalsubai Maharashtra mein (Sahyadri ki sabse unchi), aur Doddabetta Nilgiri mein hai. Exam point: pashchimi Ghat kis sabse unchi - Anamudi; pashchimi Ghat = Sahyadri = 'Sahya Parbat'.

qe: What are 'Duns' in Himalayan structural geomorphology?
qh: हिमालयी भूगोल के संदर्भ में 'दूँ' (Duns) क्या कहलाते हैं?
o: Longitudinal structural strike valleys lying between the Lesser Himalayas and the Shiwalik Range
e: Duns wo lambai (longitudinal) maidan hain jo Himalaya ke do shrinkhalon - Lesser Himalaya aur Shiwalik ke beech bane hain. Ye asal mein nadiyon dwara bane khadde (structural valleys) hain jahan nadiyan apna gaad (sediment) bhar deti hain; inka sabse bada udaharan Dehradun hai, isliye inhe Dun valley kehte hain. Patliyan (cirque) jheel barf se banti hain, granite intrusion bahar nikla pathar hai, aur Trans-Himalayan gorge nadiyon ke gehre kattav hain. Exam point: Duns = Dehradun, Kotli Dun, Patli Dun; ye Himalaya ke 4 anshon (Trans, Greater, Lesser, Shiwalik) mein Lesser aur Shiwalik ke beech padte hain.

qe: Which peak marks the highest point of the ancient Aravalli Range?
qh: प्राचीन अरावली पर्वतमाला की सबसे ऊँची चोटी कौन सी है?
e: Guru Shikhar (1722 m) Aravalli range ki sabse unchi choti hai aur ye Rajasthan mein Mount Abu ke paas sthit hai. Aravalli bharat ki sabse purani fold mountain hai jo pre-Cambrian kaal mein bani, isliye ye ab bahut ghisi (eroded) hui relict hai. Dhupgarh Satpura ki, Parasnath Chota Nagpur (Jharkhand) ki, aur Doddabetta Nilgiri ki sabse unchi choti hai. Exam point: Aravalli = duniya ki sabse purani fold mountains mein se ek; iska highest = Guru Shikhar.

qe: The Aravalli Mountain system in northwestern India is geologically classified as:
qh: उत्तर-पश्चिमी भारत में स्थित 'अरावली पर्वत' किस प्रकार के पर्वत का उदाहरण हैं?
o: Relict and Denuded Old Fold Mountains
e: Aravalli bharat ki sabse purani fold mountain shrinkhala hai jo lagbhag 1 billion saal se bhi purane kaal mein bani. Lambi samay ki eroshan (ghisai) ke karan ab ye bahut neechi aur toot-fut chuki hai, isliye ise 'relict mountains' ya 'residual hills' kehte hain. Aaj ye Rajasthan ko Delhi tak gujarti hai aur isi karan poore uttar bharat ke liye ek parvat baa ya thaandh (haat) ka kaam karti hai. Tertiary young fold, plateau escarpment ya jwalamukhi crater isse bilkul alag hai. Exam point: Aravalli = old fold (residual), Himalaya = young fold - dono ka antar yaad rakho.

qe: Which is the longest continental mountain range on Earth, traversing South America?
qh: दक्षिण अमेरिका के पश्चिमी तट पर उत्तर से दक्षिण तक फैली विश्व की सबसे लंबी पर्वत श्रृंखला कौन सी है?
e: Andes duniya ka sabse lamba khamandali (continental) parvat samuh hai jo South America ke pashchimi tat (west coast) ke saath lagbhag 7000 km chalta hai. Iska sabse uncha shikhar Aconcagua (6961 m) hai jo Argentina mein hai. Rocky Mountains North America mein, Ural Europe-Asia ki seema par aur Great Dividing Range Australia mein hai. Exam point: Andes = duniya ka sabse lamba continental fold mountain; isi ke pas Atacama registan hai kyunki ye paschimi hawa se barish ko rok deta hai.

qe: In tectonic block mountain faulting, what term designates the elevated block between normal faults?
qh: भ्रंशोत्थ पर्वत (Block Mountain) निर्माण में दो सामान्य भ्रंशों के बीच ऊपर उठे हुए भाग को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Fault (bhu-bhang) mein jab do normal faults ke beech ka bhoomi-bhag upar utha jaata hai, to us upre (elevated) block ko Horst kehte hain; neeche dhase block ko Graben (rift valley) kehte hain. Horst mountain ke udaharan - Vosges (France), Black Forest (Germany), Satpura; aur Graben ke - Narmada-Tapi valley, Great Rift Valley, Rhine valley. Syncline ek neeche ki ore jhuka fold hai aur monocline ek taraf jhuka strata hai. Exam point: Horst = upar (uncha), Graben = neeche (dabba) - Rift Valley ek Graben hai.

qe: Mount Kilimanjaro in eastern Africa is a classic example of which mountain class?
qh: तंजानिया में स्थित माउंट किलिमंजारो किस प्रकार के पर्वत का उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण है?
e: Kilimanjaro Africa ke Tanzania mein sthit hai aur ye ek jwalamukhi parvat (volcanic mountain) hai. Ye ek stratovolcano ya composite volcano hai jismein lava ki bahut si paratein jama hokar moti ho gayi, isliye ye Africa ka sabse uncha shikhar (5895 m) hai. Ye koi fold mountain ya horst nahi hai; iske teen mukhya shikhar Kibo, Mawenzi aur Shira hain. Horst mountain fault se banta hai aur residual plateau bhi alag prakriya se banta hai. Exam point: Kilimanjaro = Africa ka sabse uncha + duniya ka sabse uncha mukta khada jwalamukhi.

qe: Which active subduction boundary created the volcanic Andes mountain chain?
qh: नाज़का और दक्षिण अमेरिकी प्लेटों के टकराव से किस प्रकार के पर्वत का निर्माण हुआ?
o: Oceanic-continental subduction of the Nazca Plate under the South American Plate
e: Andes parvat samuh Nazca Plate (samudri) ke South American Plate (khamandali) ke neeche dhansne (subduction) se bana hai. Samudri plate continental plate ke neeche jaate samay andar ke dabaav aur garmi se pighal jaati hai, naya magma banta hai jo upar chadh kar jwalamukhi parvat aur deep trench banata hai. Isi karan Peru-Chile trench duniya ka sabse lamba trench hai aur yahan bhukamp aur jwalamukhi ki peti (Ring of Fire) bhi hai. Divergent rifting ya continental-continental suture isse alag prakriya hai. Exam point: Andes = oceanic-continental subduction ka classic udaharan; Narmada-Tapi rift valley = divergent ka udaharan.

qe: Near which historic location does the Ganga River enter the state of Bihar?
qh: गंगा नदी किस ऐतिहासिक स्थान के समीप बिहार राज्य की सीमा में प्रवेश करती है?
e: Ganga nadi Bihar mein Chausa (Buxar jile) ke paas pravesh karti hai. Ye Uttar Pradesh se nikalti hai, Chausa ke paas Bihar ki seema mein aati hai aur phir Bhojpur, Patna, Munger, Bhagalpur hote hue Bengal ki taraf badhti hai. Kahalgaon, Munger aur Digha sab Bihar mein aage ke sthaan hain jahan Ganga pahunchti hai, lekin pravesh ka pehla sthaan Chausa hi hai. Chausa ke paas Son nadi bhi Ganga mein milti hai. Exam point: Ganga ka Bihar pravesh - Chausa (Buxar), aur yahin se Ganga ka mamla (plain) ka vistar badhta hai.

qe: Which major irrigation canal system originating from the Valmikinagar barrage irrigates northern Bihar?
qh: वाल्मीकिनगर बैराज से निकलने वाली कौन सी नहर प्रणाली उत्तर-पश्चिमी बिहार को व्यापक सिंचाई प्रदान करती है?
e: Tribeni (Triveni) / Pashchimi Gandak Canal Valmikinagar barrage se nikalta hai. Ye Gandak nadi par bana barrage hai jahan se 3 nadiyan - Gandak, Sone aur Tamasa - judne ke karan ise Triveni bhi kehte hain. Ye canal Pashchim Champaran, Gopalganj, Siwan, Saran aur Muzaffarpur jaise uttar Bihar ke jileon ki kheti ko sinchai deta hai. Eastern Kosi Canal Kosi nadi se, Kamala Canal Kamala nadi se, aur Son High Level Canal Son nadi se juda hai. Exam point: Bihar ki mukhya canals - Gandak (Valmikinagar), Kosi (Birpur), Son (Dehri).

qe: Which peninsular river is popularly termed 'Dakshin Ganga' owing to its length and expansive basin?
qh: अपनी विशाल लंबाई और अपवाह क्षेत्र के कारण किस प्रायद्वीपीय नदी को 'दक्षिण गंगा' कहा जाता है?
e: Godavari nadi dakshin bharat ki sabse lambi nadi hai (lagbhag 1465 km) aur iska jal-grah (catchment) bhi Ganga ke baad sabse bada hai, isliye ise 'Dakshin Ganga' ya 'Vridha Ganga' kehte hain. Ye Maharashtra ke Trimbakeshwar se nikalti hai aur Telangana, Chhattisgarh, Andhra Pradesh hote hue Bay of Bengal mein girti hai. Krishna, Mahanadi aur Cauvery isse chhoti hain. Exam point: Godavari = dakshin bharat ki sabse lambi nadi + sabse bada peninsular basin.

qe: Which major peninsular river flows westward through a tectonic rift valley into the Arabian Sea?
qh: कौन सी प्रमुख प्रायद्वीपीय नदी भ्रंश घाटी से होकर पश्चिम की ओर बहती हुई अरब सागर में गिरती है?
e: Narmada ek peninsular nadi hai jo Madhya Pradesh ke Amarkantak se nikal kar pashchim ki ore seedhi (straight) behti hai aur Arabian Sea mein Khambhat ki khari (gulf) mein girti hai. Ye ek bhu-bhang (fault) ghati mein behti hai jise Narmada-Tapi rift valley kehte hain, isliye iski dharidar (course) seedhi hai aur aas-pas talus (cut) milti hai. Mahanadi, Krishna aur Godavari sab poorv ki ore Bay of Bengal mein girti hain. Exam point: Narmada aur Tapi - peninsular bharat ki do nadiyan jo pashchim ki ore behti hain, rift valley mein.

qe: At which holy confluence do the Bhagirathi and Alaknanda rivers unite to form the Ganga?
qh: भागीरथी और अलकनंदा नदियां किस प्रयाग में मिलकर आधिकारिक तौर पर 'गंगा' कहलाती हैं?
e: Devprayag mein Bhagirathi aur Alaknanda nadiyan mil kar Ganga banati hain. Devprayag ke pehle 4 aur prayag (Karnaprayag, Rudraprayag, Vishnuprayag, Nandprayag) hain jahan do-do nadiyan milti hain. Bhagirathi Gaumukh (Gangotri) se nikal kar Devprayag tak 'Bhagirathi' kehlati hai, aur Alaknanda Badrinath (Satopanth) se aati hai. Isi karan Devprayag ko Ganga ka janm-sthal maana jaata hai. Exam point: 5 Prayag - Vishnu, Nanda, Karna, Rudra, Dev; Devprayag par Ganga ka naam milta hai.

qe: Under the Indus Waters Treaty of 1960, what proportion of total water from the Indus, Jhelum, and Chenab is allocated to India for unrestricted consumption?
qh: 1960 की सिंधु जल संधि के अनुसार, पश्चिमी नदियों के कुल जल का लगभग कितने प्रतिशत उपयोग भारत कर सकता है?
e: Indus Waters Treaty 1960 (World Bank ki madhyastha se) mein bharat ko teen pashchimi nadiyon - Indus, Jhelum aur Chenab - ka 20% paani bina rok-tok (unrestricted) istemal karne ka adhikar mila, baaki 80% Pakistan ko. Iske badle bharat ko poorvi nadiyon - Ravi, Beas aur Satluj - par poora adhikar mila (unka 80%). Isliye Kishenganga aur Ratle jaise sthaan (dispute) is treaty se juda hua hai. Exam point: 1960, World Bank, 3 poorvi vs 3 pashchimi nadiyan - 20% / 80% ka hisaab yaad rakho.

qe: The world's largest delta, the Sundarbans, is deposited by which combined river network?
qh: विश्व का सबसे बड़ा डेल्टा 'सुंदरवन' किन दो प्रमुख नदियों के संगम और मुहाने द्वारा निर्मित है?
e: Sundarbans duniya ka sabse bada delta hai jo Ganga, Brahmaputra aur Meghna (Bangladesh mein) teeno nadiyon ke mil kar jama kiye gaad (sediment) se bana hai. Ye Bengal ke tat par Bengal Bangladesh mein faila hua hai aur ise mangroves (khaari ke paani ke jungle) ke liye jaana jaata hai - yahan Royal Bengal Tiger rehta hai aur ye UNESCO World Heritage Site hai. Godavari-Krishna ka delta Andhra mein hai lekin Sundarbans se chhota hai, Narmada-Tapi ka delta estuary ke roop mein hai. Exam point: Sundarbans = sabse bada delta + sabse bada mangrove jungle + Bengal tiger.

qe: On which river is the world's largest inhabited river island, Majuli, located?
qh: विश्व का सबसे बड़ा नदी द्वीप 'माजुली' किस नदी पर स्थित है?
e: Majuli duniya ka sabse bada nadi-dweep (river island) hai jo Brahmaputra nadi ke beech mein Assam mein sthit hai. Ye Majuli zile ke roop mein bhi ek prashasnik ikai hai aur yahan satra naamak Vaishnav math (monasteries) hain. Iska nirmaan Brahmaputra ki dhaara (channel) badalne se hua aur iska kshetrafal lagatar erojan se ghat raha hai. Ganga par bhi dweep hain (jaise Bihar ke Raghopur), lekin 'duniya ka sabse bada inhabited river island' Majuli hi maana jaata hai. Exam point: Majuli = Brahmaputra + duniya ka sabse bada inhabited river island.

qe: Around which high Himalayan peak does the Tsangpo/Brahmaputra execute a sharp hairpin U-turn to enter India?
qh: ब्रह्मपुत्र (त्सांगपो) नदी किस पर्वत चोटी के पास एक गहरा महाखड्ड (गॉर्ज) बनाकर भारत में प्रवेश करती है?
e: Brahmaputra plateau ke Tibet mein 'Yarlung Tsangpo' ke naam se behta hai. Himalaya se aage badhne par ye Namcha Barwa (7756 m) parvat ke paas ek tez hairpin jaisa U-turn leta hai (Dihang gorge) aur phir bharat mein Arunachal Pradesh ke roop mein pravesh karta hai; aage Assam ke mamle mein Brahmaputra kehlata hai aur Bangladesh mein Jamuna ke naam se Ganga mein milta hai. Kanchenjunga, Nanda Devi ya Dhaulagiri is jagah ke naam nahi. Exam point: Tsangpo ka hairpin turn = Namcha Barwa; duniya ka sabse gehra gorge bhi yahin (Dihang/Tsangpo).

qe: The fertile alluvial interfluve 'Bist Doab' in Punjab is bounded by which two rivers?
qh: पंजाब का उपजाऊ 'बिस्त दोआब' किन दो नदियों के मध्य स्थित भू-भाग है?
e: Bist Doab Punjab ka wo upjaau (fertile) ilaaka hai jo Beas aur Satluj nadiyon ke beech mein hai; 'Doab' ka matlab hi 'do nadiyon ke beech ka ilaaka' hota hai. Aise ilaake mein mitti upjaau hoti hai, aabadi gani hoti hai aur canal sinchai ka jaal faila hota hai Punjabi ke doosre Doab - Bari (Beas-Ravi), Rachna (Ravi-Chenab) aur Jech (Jhelum-Chenab) hain. Exam point: 'Bist' = Beas + Satluj; Punjab ke chaar Doab aur Sindh Sagar Doab (Jhelum-Indus ke beech) - kul milakar 5 Doab.

qe: The tiered 'Hundru Falls' in Jharkhand cascades down which river on the Chota Nagpur Plateau?
qh: झारखंड में छोटा नागपुर पठार पर स्थित प्रसिद्ध 'हुंडरू जलप्रपात' किस नदी पर बना है?
e: Hundru jal-prapat (waterfall) Jharkhand ke Ranchi jile mein Chota Nagpur ke plateau par Subarnarekha nadi par hai. Ye lagbhag 98 m uncha hai aur ise 'Niagara of Jharkhand' bhi kehte hain. Koel, Damodar aur Barakar Chota Nagpur ke doosre ilaake ki nadiyan hain. Subarnarekha nadi Chota Nagpur ke plateau se nikal kar Odisha-Bengal se hokar Bay of Bengal mein girti hai. Exam point: Hundru falls = Subarnarekha nadi, Ranchi; Jharkhand ke doosre prapat - Dassam (Kanke/Sahebganj), Jonha (Gunga).

qe: What fluvial geomorphic process produces an 'Ox-bow Lake' (Crescent lake)?
qh: नदी द्वारा बनाई जाने वाली 'गोखुर झील' (Ox-bow lake) के निर्माण की मुख्य प्रक्रिया क्या है?
o: A tight river meander neck being breached and cut off from the active channel during flood stages
e: Nadi jab bahut tez muraavat (meander) banati hai, to kabhi-kabhi tez dhaar ya baadh se us muraavat ki patli gardan (neck) tooti jaati hai aur ghuma hua hissa nadi se alag ho jaata hai. Uske baad us alag padi nadi mein paani ruk jaata hai (stagnant water) aur wo crescent ya ghode ki naal (horseshoe) jaisa jheel ban jaata hai, jise ox-bow lake ya crescent lake kehte hain. Tectonic collapse, caldera ya glacial scouring se aisi jheel nahi banti. Exam point: ox-bow lake = meander katne se bani jheel; Ganga-Brahmaputra ke maidan mein ye bahut aam hain (jaise Kanwar jheel, Bihar).

qe: The natural raised embankments flanking a river channel built by repetitive flood deposition are known as:
qh: नदी द्वारा बाढ़ के समय अपने किनारों पर तलछट जमा करने से बने प्राकृतिक बंधों को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Nadi apne saath barik gaad (fine sediment) laati hai. Baadh (flood) ke samay jab paani kinaron par failta hai, to tez paani sabse pehle kinare ke paas apna bojh (bhaar) chhod deta hai - kyunki rafthar wahan kam ho jaati hai. Baad mein paani hat jaata hai aur kinare par unchi-moti (raised) dhaar ban jaati hai, jise natural levee kehte hain. Ye kinare ki praakrutik bandh (embankment) manav ko baadh se kuchh suraksha deti hai, lekin nadi ka bed har baar uncha hota jaata hai. Point bar nadi ke andar ke mod par banta hai, delta muhane par, aur alluvial fan pahad ke base par. Exam point: natural levee = nadi ki praakrutik kinare wali unchi dhaar.

qe: Who famously declared modern multipurpose river valley dam projects as the 'Temples of Modern India'?
qh: बहुउद्देशीय नदी घाटी परियोजनाओं को किसने 'आधुनिक भारत के मंदिर' की संज्ञा दी थी?
e: Bharat ke pehle pradhan-mantri Jawaharlal Nehru ne bade bahu-uddeshiya (multipurpose) nadi-ghati pariyojnaon ko 'aadhunik bharat ke mandir' kaha tha. Iska matlab tha ki Bhakra Nangal, Hirakud aur Damodar Ghati jaise dam sinchai, bijli, baadh-niyantran aur peene ka paani - chaar kaam ek saath karte hain, isliye ye desh ke vikas ke aadhar hain. Dr. Ambedkar ne samvidhan banaya, Gandhi swatantrata aandolan ke, aur Patel ekikaran ke liye jaane jaate hain. Exam point: 'Mandir' wala nara - Pandit Nehru, 1950 ke dashak mein bahu-uddeshiya pariyojnaon ke udghatan ke samay.

qe: The environmental and social movement 'Narmada Bachao Andolan' mobilized protests against which mega-dam project?
qh: 'नर्मदा बचाओ आंदोलन' मुख्य रूप से किस विशाल बांध परियोजना के विरोध में शुरू हुआ था?
e: Narmada Bachao Andolan (NBA) ek paryaavaran aur manavadhikar andolan tha jiska netritva Medha Patkar ne kiya aur jise Baba Amte jaise samajsevak aur adivasi-kisanon ka samarthan mila. Iska mukhya virodh Sardar Sarovar Dam (Gujarat, Narmada nadi) ke khilaf tha, kyunki iske dubbav (submergence) se lakho log visthapit ho rahe the aur punarvasthapan (rehabilitation) pura nahi ho raha tha. Hirakud Mahanadi par, Nagarjuna Sagar Krishna par aur Tehri Bhagirathi par bana hai. Exam point: NBA = Sardar Sarovar Dam + Medha Patkar + punarvasthapan ka mudda.

qe: The prestigious 'Dronacharya Award' conferred by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports honors excellence in:
qh: युवा कार्यक्रम और खेल मंत्रालय द्वारा दिया जाने वाला 'द्रोणाचार्य पुरस्कार' किस क्षेत्र में उत्कृष्टता के लिए दिया जाता है?
e: Dronacharya Award bharat ke khel mangal (Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports) dwara har saal diya jaata hai aur ye un khiladiyon ke kocha aur nirikshak (coach/mentor) ko milta hai jinhone khiladiyon ko antarrashtriya star par jitaya. Iski shuruat 1985 mein hui aur ismein ek kansa (bronze) muri aur praman-patra milta hai. Khel ratna (major dhyan chand) khiladiyon ko, arjun award, aur sports medicine ya referee ko alag puraskar milta hai. Exam point: Dronacharya = khel prashikshak (coach) ka sabse uccha puraskar.

qe: Which Indian city is globally recognized as the 'Silicon Valley' or 'Electronic City' of India?
qh: किस भारतीय शहर को देश का प्रमुख आईटी हब होने के कारण 'इलेक्ट्रॉनिक सिटी' या 'सिलिकॉन वैली' कहा जाता है?
e: Bengaluru ko bharat ka 'Silicon Valley' ya 'Electronic City' kaha jaata hai kyunki yahin lagbhag 40% IT (software) companies, start-up aur electronic industry ka dhyaan (hub) hai. Ye Karnataka ki rajdhani hai, samundar ki satah se 900 m uncha hone se mausam suhaavna rehta hai, aur yahan IISc, Infosys, Wipro jaise sansthan hain. Hyderabad 'Cyberabad' ke naam se, Gurugram-Noida Delhi NCR ke, aur Pune bhi IT hub hai, lekin Bengaluru ka puraana naam hi 'Silicon Valley of India' hai. Exam point: IT capital = Bengaluru; Cyberabad = Hyderabad.

qe: The historic 'Durand Line' demarcates the international boundary between which two nations?
qh: 'डूरंड रेखा' किन दो देशों के बीच की अंतरराष्ट्रीय सीमा रेखा है?
e: Durand Line wo 2640 km lambi antarrashtriya seema rekha hai jo Pakistan aur Afghanistan ke beech chalti hai. Ye 1893 mein British officer Sir Mortimer Durand aur Afghan amir Abdur Rahman Khan ke beech hui ek samjhauta (agreement) se banayi gayi thi. Iski wajah se Pakistan ke Khyber Pakhtunkhwa aur Baluchistan ke ilaake Afghanistan se alag hue. India-Pakistan ki seema Radcliffe Line hai, India-China ki LAC/McMahon Line, aur India-Myanmar ki free movement wali seema. Exam point: Durand Line = Pakistan-Afghanistan; Radcliffe = India-Pakistan; McMahon = India-China.

qe: Kaziranga National Park, renowned as the primary habitat of the great Indian one-horned rhinoceros, is situated in:
qh: एक सींग वाले भारतीय गैंडे के लिए विश्व प्रसिद्ध 'काजीरंगा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान' किस राज्य में स्थित है?
e: Kaziranga National Park Assam ke Golaghat-Nagaon jile mein Brahmaputra ke baad (floodplain) par hai aur yahan duniya ka sabse bada hissa (about 2/3) ek-shingi (one-horned) gaida (rhinoceros) rehta hai. Ye 1905 mein reserve forest bana aur 1985 mein UNESCO World Heritage Site declare hua. Assam ke alawa ye gaida West Bengal ke Jaldapara aur Nepal ke Chitwan mein bhi milta hai, lekin mukhya ghar Assam hi hai. Exam point: Kaziranga = Assam = ek-shingi gaida; 'Gaida ka ghar' + 2022 mein 2613 gianda ki ginti.

qe: Which Indian state holds the largest deposits and highest annual output of crude sheet mica?
qh: भारत में 'अभ्रक' (Mica) का सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक राज्य कौन सा है?
e: Bharat mein mica ke sabse zyada bhandar aur sabse zyada utpadan Andhra Pradesh ka hai (lagbhag 40-50%), khaas kar Nellore, Chittoor aur Krishna ilaake. Mica ek sheet silicate khanij hai jo bahut patli, unchi voltage sahan karne wali aur bijli rokhne (insulation) wali hone ke karan bijli ke yantro, cable aur paint mein istemal hota hai. Jharkhand (Koderma-Gaya-Hazaribagh belt) aur Rajasthan-Bihar ki mica ki peti (belt) 'mica belt' ke naam se famous hai, par aaj utpadan mein Andhra Pradesh aage hai. Exam point: mica - 'abundant deposit' Jharkhand, 'highest production' Andhra Pradesh.

qe: The premier biennial international championship 'Sudirman Cup' is contested in which sport?
qh: अंतरराष्ट्रीय 'सुदीरमन कप' किस खेल की विश्व मिश्रित टीम चैंपियनशिप है?
e: Sudirman Cup ek antarrashtriya badminton (shuttle badminton) championship hai jismein purush aur mahila dono mil kar mixed team ke roop mein khelte hain. Ye 1989 se har do saal mein hoti hai aur iska naam Indonesia ke pehle pramukh (marshal) Sudirman ke naam par rakha gaya. Thomas Cup purush badminton ka aur Uber Cup mahila badminton ka antarrashtriya khitaab hai. Squash, tennis aur table tennis ke apne alag tournaments hain (jaise Davis Cup, Wimbledon). Exam point: Thomas (purush) + Uber (mahila) + Sudirman (mixed) - teeno badminton se juda hain.

qe: In which city is the premier earth sciences and mining institution, IIT (ISM), located?
qh: 'इंडियन स्कूल ऑफ माइन्स' (अब IIT धनबाद) किस शहर में स्थित है?
e: IIT (ISM) - puraana naam Indian School of Mines - Dhanbad, Jharkhand mein sthit hai aur ye bharat ka sabse purana khanij (mining) aur prithvi vigyan (earth sciences) ke kshetra mein sabse ahem sansthan hai. Ye 1926 mein koyla ki khaan ke liye engineer banane ke liye shuru hua tha aur ab IIT ke roop mein bhi apni pehchan rakhta hai. Ranchi, Jamshedpur aur Asansol bhi Jharkhand ke bade shahar hain lekin IIT (ISM) Dhanbad mein hai - aur Dhanbad ko 'Coal Capital of India' kehte hain. Exam point: IIT (ISM) = Dhanbad, Jharkhand = khanij shiksha ka hub.

qe: Why does planet Mars exhibit a reddish hue, earning the name 'Red Planet'?
qh: किस यौगिक की प्रचुरता के कारण मंगल ग्रह लाल रंग का दिखाई देता है?
o: Abundant Iron Oxide (rust) on its regolith and soil surface
