e: Mangal (Mars) ko 'Red Planet' kehte hain kyunki uski satah par aur regolith (dhool-patthar) mein iron oxide (lok+ (rust) ki matra bahut zyada hai, jo uske pathar aur dhool ko laal-bhoora rang deti hai. Uske baad dhool hawa mein fail jaati hai aur poore grah ko laal dikhati hai. Mangal ka patla vayumandal CO2 se bana hai, wahan taral bromine samundar ya jeevit jwalamukhi nahi hain, aur methane ice ke sanshodhan (traces) mile hain. Exam point: Mars = iron oxide (rust) = red colour; iska sabse uncha parvat Olympus Mons aur sabse lamba canyon Valles Marineris duniya ke record hain.

qe: Which maritime state boasts the longest mainland coastline in India?
qh: भारत के किस राज्य की मुख्य भूमि तटरेखा सबसे लंबी है?
e: Bharat ke mukhya bhoomi (mainland) tat ki sabse lambi seema Gujarat ki hai - lagbhag 1600 km, jismein Kutch, Kathiawar (Saurashtra) aur Khambhat ki khaari (gulf) ke bahut se tat aur creeks hain. Iske baad Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra aate hain. Gujarat ka Gulf of Kutch aur Gulf of Khambhat ke karan iska tatrekha bahut tedha-medha hai, jisse total lambai badh jaati hai. Exam point: sabse lambi mainland coastline = Gujarat; total (dweep sahit) coastline = Andhra Pradesh + Gujarat ka aankda alag-alag source mein hota hai.

qe: Through how many Indian states does the Tropic of Cancer (23.5° N) pass?
qh: 'कर्क रेखा' (23.5° N) भारत के कुल कितने राज्यों से होकर गुजरती है?
e: Kark rekha (Tropic of Cancer, 23.5 degree North) bharat ke 8 rajya se gujarti hai - Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura aur Mizoram. Ye 8 rajya 'Tropic of Cancer states' kehlate hain aur iska sabse ahem naam '8' hi hai. Ye line poorv-pashchim ki ore bharat ke beech se gujarti hai aur iske 8 rajya ko chhukar nikal jaati hai. Iska vistrit (length) bhi 3600 km se bhi zyada hai. Exam point: Tropic of Cancer bharat ke 8 rajya se gujarti hai.

qe: Through which town in Uttar Pradesh does the Standard Meridian of India (82°30' E) pass?
qh: भारत का मानक समय मध्याह्न (82°30' E रेखा) उत्तर प्रदेश के किस स्थान से गुजरता है?
e: Bharat ka Standard Meridian (82 degree 30 minute East) Uttar Pradesh ke Mirzapur (Allahabad ke paas) se gujarta hai. Isi line se bharat ka ek hi samay (IST) nirdharit hota hai, jo duniya ke UTC se 5 ghante 30 minute aage hai. Mirzapur ko isi liye 'Standard Time ka shahar' bhi kehte hain. Varanasi, Gorakhpur aur Lucknow is line se alag hain; isliye ye jawab Mirzapur hai. Exam point: 82 degree 30 minute East = bharat ka standard meridian, Mirzapur (UP) se gujarta hai; ise 1925 mein apnaya gaya.

qe: Which is the smallest Indian state by geographical surface area?
qh: क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से भारत का सबसे छोटा राज्य कौन सा है?
e: Kshetrafal (area) ke hisaab se bharat ka sabse chhota rajya Goa hai - lagbhag 3702 square km. Ye pashchimi tat par sthit hai aur 1961 tak Portuguese shasan mein tha, isliye wahan ka kanoon (civil code), sanskriti aur architecture alag hai. Sikkim (7096 sq km) chhota hai lekin Goa se bada, Tripura (10486 sq km) aur Nagaland (16579 sq km) bhi bade hain. Delhi jaise kendra-shasit kshetra (UT) rajya ki list mein nahi aate. Exam point: area mein sabse chhota rajya = Goa; area mein sabse bada rajya = Rajasthan; aabadi ghanatva mein sabse kam = Arunachal Pradesh.

qe: Which city is termed the 'Manchester of India' due to its textile mill concentration?
qh: अपने विशाल सूती वस्त्र उद्योग के कारण किस शहर को 'भारत का मैनचेस्टर' कहा जाता है?
e: Ahmedabad ko 'bharat ka Manchester' kehte hain (ku) kyunki yahin kapas (cotton) tekstail mill ka sabse purana aur ghani (dense) udyog hai. Manchester Britain ka vishaal tekstail shahar tha, isliye tulna ke liye yahi naam diya gaya. Ahmedabad ki 1861 ki mill se bharat ke modern tekstail udyog ki shuruat hui. Kanpur ko 'bharat ka Manchester' bhi kehte hain (vastra ke liye), Mumbai 'Cottonopolis' ya 'City of Mills', aur Coimbatore 'bharat ka Manchester' (South) ya 'Textile City' kehlata hai. Exam point: textile capital = Ahmedabad + Mumbai; 'Manchester of India' = Ahmedabad.

qe: In which ocean basin is Challenger Deep, within the Mariana Trench, located?
qh: विश्व का सबसे गहरा गर्त 'मारियाना ट्रेंच' किस महासागर में स्थित है?
e: Challenger Deep duniya ka sabse gehra sthaan hai - lagbhag 10,935 m - aur ye Mariana Trench ke andar, pashchimi Pacific Ocean mein hai, Guam ke paas. Ye ek subduction zone (Mariana Arc) ka sabse gehra hissa hai jahan Pacific plate chhote Mariana plate ke neeche dhans gaya. 1960 mein Jacques Piccard aur Don Walsh ne pehli baar yahan dive kiya; 2012 mein James Cameron ne bhi. Arctic, Indian aur Atlantic sagar isse bahut kam gehre hain. Exam point: sabse gehra sthaan - Challenger Deep (Mariana Trench, Western Pacific); Sunda Trench (Java) doosra sabse gehra hai.

qe: Morabadi Ground, a prominent cultural hub and street market, is located in which capital city?
qh: मोराबादी मैदान किस राज्य की राजधानी का एक प्रमुख क्षेत्र है?
e: Morabadi Ground Jharkhand ki rajdhani Ranchi mein sthit hai - yahan khel ke maidan, mela, sabha aur street market sab hote hain aur ye shahar ke beech ka ek bada khula maidan hai. Raipur (Chhattisgarh), Bhubaneswar (Odisha) aur Patna (Bihar) apni-apni rajdhani hain lekin Morabadi unmein nahi hai. Ranchi ko 'City of Waterfalls' bhi kehte hain kyunki yahan Dassam, Jonha aur Hundru jaise prapat hain. Exam point: Morabadi Ground = Ranchi (Jharkhand) ka sabse bada khula maidan aur saanskritik kendra.
